tei:div.tei:p: chi —kyārīchi riju ri —tsho rīju 3ri ci rī rngaci su rgyurīri— shrī cha 3 ge ci ji 4ci ri la— 3 ri pace ricarir+ṣa rīca dhechi ri —ji༄ jiri 4chicat+yā4smerīrīdutrī —ci — ca rīkrorkedī —3sdupe shādzor+ṣa— ji /—3 dro / zhu rnyi//rnanīlte(snye wa wane1 sku ri me+e ༷‘ lti dze nerdi—rī3rdziridzeju 4 chi3 /〉twebyurtsocici——4 cisnye ri rī— gyi tho ste sde—ci3 ༷ wa wawa ram̐ — wa ci ci ci wa rir+ṣa tre ṭ+wāṃ/ r+ghaṃ 3nya rmohūṃrna / waṭ+wāṃX tswa ci sdur+sha8༷(smo snyernga rimosngirdo py-i 4 /3cismu kārdordo/tsho riḥ4gyu si swāju dzirī bi sko ci5 kyiskoshā/ ṭaṃri ṇatsām+birti rdo shā rdzitsho lgemi/ ‘

blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod/deb phreng bdun pa/sher phyin gyi mdo dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa lung don rgya mtsho/mdzad pa po/ shākya mchog ldan dri med legasapa'i blo gros/

dkar chagashis brjod/ 09sngonagleng / 13dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 15sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rtsa ba/ 19sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel lung don rgya mtsho/ 45skabs dang lngardzo rnam mkhyen bstan pa/ 45'grel ba'i mchod brjod dang bshad par dam bca'/ 45rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i mdo gang yin pa/ 46rgyan la srol 'byed du zhig yod pa/ 4711la 'byed de dag las gang gi rjes su 'brangs pa 47gus pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ 48bstan bcos la dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos sogs chos bzhi/ 58bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi/ 59dbye gzhi sher phyin ngos gzung ba/ 59dbye ngo bshad bya mngon rtogs brgyad so sor bshad pa/ 60'chad byed don bdun cu'i yan lag rgyas bshad/ 63

4 dkar chagasems bskyed dngos bshad pa/ 64zhar la gzhan yang bshad pa/ 64sgrub pa'i gdams ngag spyir bshad pa/ 66gdams ngag bye brag tu bshad pa/ 67sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 67dmigs yul bden bzhi la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 69rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 90rtogs dka' ba dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa/ 95mi mthun phyogs sel byed brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 111spyan dang mngon shes la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 112sgrub pa mthar thug rgyu mthong sgom la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 115sgrub pa'i dang po nges byed yan lag 116sgrub pa'i rten/ 119sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ 123sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa/ 126sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo/ 127sgrub pa'i dbye ba/ 128go cha'i sgrub pa/ 128'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ 129tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ 140nges 'byung gi sgrub pa/ 144

dkar chag 5skabs gnyis pa lam thegs bstan pa/ 145rgyu'i gtso bo lam shes kyi yan lag 145yan lag can gyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 146nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ 146rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ 147byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ 148theg chen mthong lam khyad par can/ 149theg chen 〉(ma lam/ 150mos pa yid byed kyi sgom lam/ 151bsngo ba yid byed kyi sgom lam/ 152rjes su yi rang sgom lam/ 153zag med sgom lam/ 153theg chen sgrub pa sgom lam/ 153rnam dag sgom lam/ 153skabs garna/ma pa gzhi 6)sa bstan pa/ 156'jug yul gzhi shes/ 156dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba/ 158shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba/ 161sbyor ba mnyam nyid/ 161dngos bstan byang sems mthong lam 161

6 dkar chagashugs bstan theg dman mthong lam 162skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs ྅༷ra ba bstan pa/ 163rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i yan lag rgyas bshad/ 163bsgom bya'i rnam pa/ 163sgom pa po'i gang zag 180sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ 180rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam ngos gzung ba/ 183rten gyi gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i phan yon/ 183sku gsum so sor nges pa'i rgyu sbyor ba/ 184'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba/ 185skabs lnga pa rtse sbyor bstan pa/ 187so so skye bo'i rtse sbyor/ 187'phags pa'i rtse sbyor/ 188spang bya rtog pa/ 188nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis spangs pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa/ 189lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ 190'bras bu byang chub dngos/ 190zhar la rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi bshad pa/ 190nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor nyid bshad pa/ 191mnyam bzhag seṅge rnam bsgyings/ 192

dkar chag 7rjes thob rten 'brel rtogs tshul/ 192gnyen po sgom lam rtse sbyor/ 198sbyor ba seṅge rnam bsgyings bshad pa/ 198dngos gzhi thod rgal/ 199spang bya rtog pa/ 200skabs drug pa mthar gyis pa'i rjeXr ba bstan pa/ 203rgyu mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ 203lam gyi ngo bo phyin drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ 203rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ 204ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ 205skabs bdun pa skad cig ma'i rjeXr ba bstan pa/ 206'bras bu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dngos/ 206rtogs byed blo'i sgo nas yon tan mngon du byed pa'i skad cig sbyor/ 206rtogs bya yul gyi sgo nas yul rtogs tshul gyi skad cig sbyor/ 207sbyor bzhi'i don ldog bsdus te bshad pa/ 207skabs basbyo/da pa 'bras n+da/ cesas ྅/ bstan pa/ 210'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ 210sku la tshul bzhi yi 〈sna nas dbye ba/ 210ye shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 215

8 dkar chagame long lta bu'i ye shes/ 215mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ 216so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 216bya ba sdo/ba pa'i ye shes/ 218sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid/ 218gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa'i 'phrin las/ 219lam la 'god pa'i 'phrin las/ 219lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa'i 'phrin las/ 219dpe skrun smon tshig 225

/ ( k+ṣ-ido dze——ḍakyici /sdowawa ne+e ༷tshordo tre dākā / / smyo rī nga nar༅༅// susti/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbus na pad dkar ltar/ /bsngags pa'i gzi /// 'od stong 'bar rab 'phro zhing / /snyigs dus 'gro la lhag par brtseb yis/ /rtag tu / // skyong mdzad shākya'i rgyal por 'dud/ /khyod bstan yongs rdzogs pyar rgyal gangs ljongs // su / / dus kyi rim pas snga 'gyur gsar ma zhes/ /grags pa'i bye brag sgrub brgyud // kam tshang pa'i/ /don ldan snyan pa bzang po dang ba'i yul/ /deng 'dir bstan rgyun yun du skyong ba'i slad/ /gdams pa'i mdzod rnams gcig las du maru/ /bkyeba'im //smad lhag bsam 'o mtsho yis/ /las kyi 'khor lo'i rba rlabs 'phyur 'dir bsngags// /rgyu rjedar 'brel kun bde bar rab 'aces deng / /rgyu bzang rten 'brel thabs shes lam / zhugs mthus/ /rgyu yi 'bras bu mthar thug rnam mkhyen sar/ /rgyu chosags rgya mchos dang /bcas sku/na par smon// /ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon bla brang nas bod kyi chos brgyud spyi dang / / bye brag sgrub brgyud kam tshang gi phyag dbe dkon rigs khag sdug sas mtha' yas pa'i mdzod // ces pa'i deb phreng du rim pas 'don spel bya 'char la/ 'di nas smon tshig cig dgos par /// rten bcas bskul ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge sbyong tu la'i bla mas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me // phag zla 10 tshes 19 dang / phyi lo da007 zla 11 tshes 28 nyin sbyar ba'o// /// (7po /

/ sko na ’/ tso skre dze+e /zo r+sha 1khri0 1ṭ+wāṃ snye(0kyi 3jipa ༄za// 'jam mgon bla brang nas gsung rab spyi dang bye brag skyabasarje 'jamamagon kong sprul / rin po che dang / gang gi ring lugasasgrub brgyud rka tshang pa'i dpe rgyun nye bar mkho yang rnye da / son dka' ba'i rigs blo grosamatha' yasapa'i mdzod cesapa'i deb phreng gi rnam par don gnyer can rnamasakyi dpal du gsar bzhengasazhu ba'i lasarim la rjesasuyi rang dang / kun tu spyod pa 'dis rlabs chen rgyal ba'i bstan par bya ba byed pa'i mig dper 'gyur zhing / 'jam mgon bla ma'i phrin lasargyasapa'i masnyen rkyen du 'gyur ba'i re smon bcas/ karma pa o rgyan phrin lasardo rjes/ nang lo 2551 phyi lo 2007 zla 8 pa'i tshes 27 la/ —jid wa

)sam60so50so612pu1ji42samakha6༄7/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad nyid bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du gang gdul gyi rnam par rol pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang gis mdzes pa'i skyes rabs phreng bar bstar ba las/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 7skyabs rje 'jam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum pa mchog gi bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs bla med du mar mchis la/ gus 'bangs gang gi zhabs 'bring du 'khod pa rnams kyis 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dgung du 'degs pa'i srid zhur rlom nas/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig 'dril gyi 'bad pas dgongs 'char 'khod pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig rags rim nas bsgrubs zin pa'i khul yin zhing / mdzad don lhag mar lus pa rnams las gtso bo zhig ni spyir ris med kyi gsung rab dang lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab med du mi rung ba rnams dus 'gyur gyi pho nyas lkog tu sbas pas dpe rgyun dkon zhing phal cher nub la nye ba rnams 'tshol sgrub kyis srung skyob bstan pa nam gnas su byed pa'i dpe mdzod tshad du 'byol ba zhig dang / de'i yan lag tu gsung rab de dag don gnyer can yongs la 'grems spel khyab brdal du bya ba'i gsung rab dpe skrun sde tshan zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po yod pa ma tshad 7skyabs rje nyid la bod nas phyag dpe mi nyung ba tsam phyag son byung zin pa sogs mdzad 'char de dus nas dbu 'dzugs mdzad pa lags/

de ltar 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi bzhed don gtso bor gnas pa bzhin gus 'bangs rnams nas kyang de nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bzung nas 'bad rtsol nus 'tshams zhig bsten kyang dpal 'byor dang zhu sgrig pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'i rkyen gyis bsam sbyor don thog tu ma 'khel bar da bar rim lus su gyur/ da cha mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dus su sad pas gnas mi longs spyod sogs gang 'thad nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyis gom bgrod mdun bskyod thub tsam byung ba las brtas pa'i dga' spro ni bdag cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i snying por 'o༈gums/des na da lan sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan 7rgyal dbang karma pa 6( rgyan 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje mchog la gsol ba btab don bzhin spar skrun gyi mtshan byang du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi deb phreng zhes pa dang / deb phreng 'di yi sngon brjod thugs smon zab rgyas kyis brjed pa bka' drin bskyangs pas dbu btsugs te gsung rab deb phreng du spel ba'i las 'char 'di bzhin spel ba lags/ rnam dkar gyi bgyi ba 'di nyid kyi 'bras bur bstan 'gror sman pa rlabs chen rgya che rgyun mi chad du 'byung bas mgon po gang gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchod dam par gyur te/ bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar thugs rje'i ra gur las mi 'dor bar tshe rabs kun tu zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang rgyun ldan las thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig bcas deb phreng 'grems spel gyi ngo sprod du/ 'jam mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'jin rdo rjes spyi lo 2008zla 1 tshes 7 nyin/

dpe spro/na gsal ngakhrind/spyir rang re bka' brgyud pa ni sgrub pa'i bka' bab yin zhes gangs can pa yongs kyi zhal rgyun du grags pa bzhin bka' brgyud gong ma rnam gsum gyi sku dus su dbang rnon cig car ba'i chos skal thabs grol gyi lam 'ba' zhig la sgrub pa snying por mdzad cing grub thob kyi tshang brdol ba las gzhung chen khag la bshad pa gtsor 'don gyi srol rgyun cher ma byung yang / rim par gdul bya dbang po je rtul du song ba na dus bab kyi 'gro don du dgongs nas rgyal dbang rje bdun pa dang brgyad pa sogs kyis gzhung chen khag la dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mang du brtsams shing bshad pa'i sde rgya cher spel ba'i sgo nas gdul bya theg pa rim 'jug tu bkri ba'i mdzad 'phrin rlabs chen bskyangs/ khyad par du rje brgyad pas bka' bar pa'i dgongs don sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar brjod pa'i bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan dang 'grel ba don gsal gnyis shan sbyar gyi 'grel ba rje btsun ngal gso zhes pa ljags rtsom mdzad/ de'i 'grel tshul yang rtsa ba'i skabs mdzad pa po rje btsun byams mgon dang shing rta'i srol 'byed slob dpon thogs med yab sras kyi dgongs pa'i gtad so mthar thug tu gnas pa'i dbu ma gzhan stong ltar du bkral ba dang / 'grel ba don gsal ni slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i dgongs don bzhin dbu ma rang rgyud par bkral ba yin zhes rje btsun mi bskyod rdo rje rang nyid kyis gsal bar gsungs kyang / 'di'i thad bod 'grel phal cher las gsung sgros tha dad cing rtogs dka' ba dang / dka' 'grel

16 dpe skrun gsal bshad/mtha' dpyod gsal kha can 'ga' yang med pas thad kar rang stobs kyis 'jug dka' ba'i gnas su mchis/ de tsam du ma zad bar lam gang gi gsung rab kyi zla dkyil yang gangs can spyi mthun las lan phyi nang dus 'gyur snga phyi'i sgra gcan gyi btson du tshud de 'chad nyan gyi zer rgyun nub nas ring por lon pa na/ 7dpal rgyal dbang bcu drug pa mchog gis rmad byung thugs bskyed zab mos gsung rab dpe rgyun 'tshol sgrub kyis par skrun mdzad/ 'chad nyan gyi sde btsugs/ bshad pa'i rgyun spel bar mdzad pa sogs gnad smin gyi mdzad phrin rlabs chen bstan 'gro'i gsos su bka' drin bskyangs pa dang /rgyal dbang bcu bdun pa mchog gis kyang deng sang lung gi bstan pa'i dus su son pas gzhung chen khag la thos bsam gyis rgyud smin par bya ba nyid thun min man ngag thabs grol lam gyi 'bab stegs su bca' 'jug dgos gnad bka' slob zab bstsal rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin lam ston rlabs chen dbu khrid mdzad pa ste/ gang gi rmad byung thugs bskyed lha lam yangs por gsang gsum snang gter mdzad phrin 'od stong bstan 'gro'i dpal yon du lham mer shar ba'i dge mtshan nyag cig la brten bshad sgrub pad tshal ci dgar bzhad cing blo gsal ra yig gnyis tshogs don gyi sbrang rtsir ngoms med spyod par gyur pa las/ 'di ga 'jam mgon kong sprul lwa ba bka' dgon bshad grwa'i slob gnyer ba rnams kyis 'dzin rim skabs bab sher 'grel rje btsun ngal gsor thos bsam zhu skabs dag snang gzigs rgyang yangs pa'i ngang / de'i rgyab chos su bod 'grel gsal kha can mi nyung ba dpe klog brgyud paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel rgyas bsdus gnyis po 'di

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 17nyid go bde zhing gsung sgros mthun shas che bas rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi dgongs don nor bu'i bang mdzod sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde'u mig lta bur nyams su myong ba rgyu mtshan du bgrangs nas/ 'di nyid par 'grems thub na skal mnyam blo gsal slo/ba gnyer ba mang por kha tsha dgos gtugs phan rlabs che nges zhes bsam 'char skul ma nan tan byung ba'i rkyen byas nas bstan bcos 'di nyid deng dus kyi deb gzugs su blo 17sa mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng bdun pa'i khongs su dpar du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar dge bas snyigs dus skye 'gro'i lus sems sdug bsngal gyi nad rims gtan du zhi zhing rnam grol dgos 'dod char du nyil ba'i gsol 'debs zhu ba dang / gzhung 'di'i ma dper mngon gsal dod pa'i yig nor ram yig 'bru mi gsal ba khag dang sa bcad 'khrugs pa sogs la gang shes gzhung mthun dag bcos bgyis khul chad lhag gnong ba ci mchis rgya che'i gzigs pa po'i spyan sngar mthol bshags dge 'don skyon sel dgongs 'char lam ston lhug stsol yong ba'i re skul zhu/rig pa'i rdo rje gtsug lag slob gnyer khang yig gsog dang rtsom sgrig sde tshan nas 2008 zla 11 tshes 5 nyin/

༄༅ / /rgya gar skad du/ a bhi sa ma ya a laṅgā ra nā ma pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta u pa de sha shā s+t+ra/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang / /'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang / /gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ /ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang / /gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te/ /chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi/ /mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas/ /blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir/ /bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes/ /bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang / /rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad/ /sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang / /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang / /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni/ /go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang / /tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams/ /thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /mog mog por byed la sogs dang / /slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang / /'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis/ /phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam/ /byed pa dang ni mos pa dang / /bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang / /bsngo dang

20 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/rjes su yi rang dang / /yid la byed pa bla med dag /sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes/ /bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang / /thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang / /thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid/ /mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang / /sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang / /nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam/ /de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang / /yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas/ /thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang / /slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang / /zhing dag bla na med pa ni/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste/ /'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin/ /de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang / /brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang / /mthong zhes bya dang sgom pa zhes/ /bya ba'i lam ni so so la/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi/ gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni/ /rtse mo'i mngon/ rtogs mthar gyis pa/ /rnam gsum rnam bcu skad cig ma/ /gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa/ /mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /de dang de ni mdo bzhin du/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod/ /de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis/ /rnam

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 21pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum/ /ma zhen yongs su mi ngal dang / /lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang / /spyan lnga dang ni mngon shes kyi/ /yon tan drug dang mthong lam dang / /sgom zhes bya la gdams ngag ni/ /bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya/ /dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs / /bar chad gcig par skyes nas dang / /byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro/ /'phar gsum srid rtse mthar thug 'gro/ /gzugs kyi chags bcom mthong ba yi/ /chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed/ /bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o/ /dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa yi/ /drod sogs dag nyid ji bzhin du/ /rnam rtog bzhi po ldan brten pa/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams/ /nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang / /bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags/ /dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /bden pa'i rten can de yi ni/ /rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog /theg pa gsum char 'thob pa'i rgyu/ /gzugs sogs 'du 'god gnas bral dang / /gnas dang btags dang brjod du med/ /gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni/ /de yi ngo bo rang bzhin med/ /de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig /de mi rtag sogs par mi gnas/ /de rnams de yi ngo bos stong / /de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig /chos rnams mi 'dzin gang yin dang / /de dag mtshan mar mi mthong phyir/ /shes rab kyis ni yongs rtog pa/ /thams cad dmigs su med par ro/ /gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid/ /de med pa nyid ngo bo nyid/ /de dag skye med nges 'byung med/ /dag dang de dag mtshan ma med/ /de yi mtshan mar mi brten pas/ /mos min 'du shes med pa yin/ /ting 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid/ /lung ston pa dang rlom

22 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/pa zad/ /gsum po phan tshun ngo bo gcig /ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa/ /de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin/ /gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis/ /gzung bar rtog pa rnam pa gnyis/ /rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis/ /de ni so sor rnam pa dgu/ /rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyis/ /'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang / /phung sogs rten las de bzhin no/ /sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ /ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba/ /rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin/ /rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang / /gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang / /de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang / /shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang / /slob ma thun mong min nyid dang / /gzhan gyi don gyi go rim dang / /ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar/ /'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya/ /chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin/ /brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ /de yang dge la sogs pa yin/ /'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang / /gang dag 'jig rten 'das 'dod dang / /zag bcas zag pa med chos dang / /gang dag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang / /gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min/ /sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang / /spong dang rtogs dang gsum po la/ /chen po gsum gyi rang byung gi /ched du bya ba 'di shes bya/ /de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis/ /go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin de/ /drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang / /lam dang byams la sogs pa dang / /dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang / /'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang / /

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 23ched du bya dang mngon shes drug /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni/ /'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la/ /'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya/ /brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang / /zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang dang / /thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang / /ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang / /lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang / /gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa yin par shes par bya/ /yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te/ /bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang / /sems can rnams la sems mnyam nyid/ /gtong dang bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / /dam chos dmigs pa 'tshol ba dang / /rtag tu nges 'byung sems nyid dang / /sangs rgyas sku 'dod dga' ba dang / /chos ston pa dang bden pa yi/ /tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod/ /'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /yongs su sbyong ba shes par bya/ /tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod/ /rab tu dga' dang snying brtse che/ /bkur bsti bla ma la gus nyan/ /brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson/ /thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zang zing med par chos sbyin dang / /sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang / /'khor bas yongs su mi skyo dang / /ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba/ /rlom med bdag nyid de rnam lnga/ /nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang / /sbyangs pa yang dag sdom rten dang / /bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang / /'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang / /mya ngan 'das dang bdog kun gtong / /mi zhum pa dang lta ba med/ /'dris dang khyim la 'khren pa dang / /'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas dang ni/ /bdag bstod gzhan la brnyas pa dang / /mi dge'i las kyi lam bcu dang / /rlom pas khengs dang phyin ci log /blo ngan dang ni nyon mongs bzod/ /bcu po 'di ni rnam spangs na/ /sa lnga pa ni yang dag 'thob/ /spyin

24 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab rab rdzogs pas/ /slob ma dang ni bse ru la/ /dga' dang skrag pa'i sems spangs pa/ /bslangs na mi zhum bdog pa kun/ /gtong yang mi dga' med pa dang / /dbul yang slong ba mi spong bas/ /sa ni drug pa yang dag 'thob/ /bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang / /srog dang gang zag chad rtag dang / /mtshan ma rgyu dang phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched dag dang ni/ /khams gsum po la gnas dang chags/ /sems mi kun tu zhum pa dang / /dkon mchog gsu5/ dang tshul khrims la/ /der lta ba yi mngon zhen dang / /stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang / /de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ni/ /nyi shu gang la rnam chad pa/ /de yis sa ni bdun pa 'thob/ /rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang / /'khor gsum rnam par dag nyid dang / /snying rje dang ni rlom med dang / /chos mnyam nyid dang tshul gcig shes/ /mi skye ba dang bzod shes dang / /chos rnams rnam pa gcig tu ston/ /rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang / /'du shes lta dang nyon mongs sbong / /zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang / /lhag mthong la ni mkhas pa dang / /sems dul ba dang thams cad la/ /thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang / /chags pa'i sa min gar 'dod par/ /zhing gzhan du ni mnyam 'gro dang / /kun tu bdag gi ngo bo ni/ /ston pa nyid dang nyi shu'o/ /sems can kun yid shes pa dang / / mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing bzang sgrub pa dang / /yongs su brtag phyir sangs rgyas bsten/ /dbang po shes dang rgyal ba yi/ /zhing sbyong sgyu ma ltar gnas dang / /bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang / /las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad/ /smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang / /lha la sogs pa'i skad shes dang / /sbobs pa chu bo lta bu dang / /mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang ni/ /rigs dang rus

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 25dang cho 'brang dang / /'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni/ /nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams dang / /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni/ /gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ /bcu pa yin par shes par bya/ /mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams/ /nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya/ /ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang / /sems can don dang 'bad med dang / /mtha' las 'das par nges 'byung dang / /thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges 'byung dang / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang / /lam gyi yul can nges 'byung ste/ /rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'di/ /nges 'byung sgrub pa yin shes bya/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi skabs te dang po'o// //lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'od kyis mog mog por mdzad dang / /yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang / /rang bzhin dang ni de yi las/ /lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni/ /nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya/ /'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa stong pa'i phyir/ /stong pa nyid rnams dbyer med pas/ /dro ba de dag mi dmigs pas/ /rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod/ /de la rtag la sogs tshul gyis/ /gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams/ /sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni/ /mi gnas rgyas par bstan pa yis/ /chos kyi mchog tu gyur bshad de/ /ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis/ /mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ /rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i

26 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/phyir/ /gzhan gyis bstan yang mi dgos la/ /bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni/ /zab ba nyid du mngon par brjod/ /gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /ji lta ji ltar nyan 'dod pa/ /de de la don de dang de/ /sgra med kyang de de ltar snang / /gzung don rtog pa sbong phyir dang / /'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /yang dag bsdus par shes par bya/ /btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ /ston pa'i rnam pa dror gyur pa/ /rtse mor gyur pa gzugs la sogs/ /'grib pa med la sogs pas phye/ /nang stong nyid la sogs pa yis/ /gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa/ /gzugs sogs skye ba med sogs kyi/ /rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog /bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /shes pa'i skad cig rnam bzhi yis/ /lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam/ /phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do/ /de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /phan tshun brten pa rten med phyir/ /rnam grangs khas mi len pa dang / /chen po tshad ma med bcas dang / /tshad med pa dang mtha' med dang / /der gnas gzugs la sogs pa la/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'dzin dang / /blang med do ra ba med sogs dang / /byams la sogs dang stong nyid dang / /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob pa dang / /rnam par byang kun yongs bsdus dang / /nyam nga ba dang nad kun sel/ /mya ngan 'das 'dzin zhi nyid dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis srung la sogs/ /srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni/ /bdag nyid gnas te sems can dag /'god dang sbyin pa la sogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba/ /lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /kun nas zhi dang thams cad la/ /'dud dang nyon mongs las rgyal dang / /gnod pas brdzi ba med nyid dang / /byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ /mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /rang gzhan don dang gzhan don

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 27dang / /rnam gsum shes bya de yang ni/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po ste/ /so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis/ /de yang rnam gsum de ltar na/ /rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni/ /dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod pa dang / /bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod/ /yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs/ /rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can/ /thabs bcas mtshan ma med pa dang / /sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang / /khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang / /chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi/ /bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po/ /bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /dge ba'i rtsa la yi rang ba/ /rjes su yi rang yid byed pa/ /sgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do/ /de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /kun la mngon par 'du mi byed/ /chos rnams dmigs su med par ni/ /gtod par byed pa don chen nyid/ / sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang / /thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa/ /'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin/ /chos kyis 'phongs pa'i rgyu dag ni/ /bdud kyis thibs kyis non pa dang / /zab mo'i chos la mi mos dang / /phung po la sogs mngon zhen dang / /sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs zin pa'o/ /'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ /de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing / /bcad du med pas dag par brjod/ /nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba/ /sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /chen po la sogs dri ma yi/ /gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la/ /

28 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /de la klan ka spangs pa yis/ /lam ni 'jal dang gzhal bya dag /mnyam pa nyid kyis khams gsum gyi/ /gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/ lam shes pa'i nyid kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /de dag bar na mi gnas pa/ /dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste/ /de ni thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad/ /gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /dus gsum gtogs pa'i chos rnams dang / /sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la/ /spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /gzhan dag de la sbyor byed pa/ /de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas/ /rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ /chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong ba yin/ /mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis/ /de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad/ /gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod/ /de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la/ /mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag gi /rnam par dbye ba ma lus pa/ /ji skad bshad pa 'dir shes bya/ /gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang / /de la chags pa med nyid la/ /spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang / /mi 'gyur byed po med nyid dang / /bya dka' rnam gsum sbyor ba dang / /skal ba ji bzhin 'bras thob pas/ /'bras yod 'dod pa de dang ni/ /gzhan la rag las min

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 29gang dang / /snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do/ /gzugs la sogs pa rlom med pa/ /rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid/ /sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /chos shes rjes su shes pa dang / /bzod shes skad cig bdag nyid 'di/ /kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam/ /gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /mtha' las 'das dang rnam dag dang / /ma skyes mi 'gag la sogs dang / /mkha' 'dra chags pa spangs pa dang / /yongs su 'dzin las grol ba dang / /ngo bo nyid kyis brjod med dang / /gang phyir 'di don brjod pa yis/ /gzhan la sbyin du med pa dang / /dmigs pa med par byed pa dang / khaṃn tu rnam dag nad mi 'byung / /ngan song chad dang 'bras bu ni/ /mngon du bya la mi rtog nyid/ /mtshan ma dag dang mi 'brel dang / /dngos dang ming dang gnyis po la/ /shes pa skye ba med pa ni/ /kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang / /yang 'di yin te rnam gsum po/ /'di ni gnas skabs gsum po dag /rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de/ /kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir/ /de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ /mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar/ /bden pa so so la bzhi dang / /lam la de ni bco lngar bshad/ /rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang / /'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin/ /de dag brgyad dang bdun dang ni/ /lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so/ /dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ /sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug rnams/ /lam gyi bden

30 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/pa'i rjes mthun par/ /kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na/ /slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas rnams la rim bzhin de/ /sum cu bdun dang sum cu bzhi/ /sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed/ /sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ /'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ /sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas/ /len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ /de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir/ /de yi de bzhin nyid zab phyir/ /de rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ /de dag tshad ni med phyir dang / /tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir/ /lung bstan phyir mi ldog nyid dang / /nges 'byung bar chad med bcas dang / /byang chub nye dang myur ba dang / /gzhan don 'phel med 'grib med phyir/ /chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong / /gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong / /gzugs sogs de yi mtshan ma dang / /de yi ngo bo rnam mi rtog /'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang / /de ni dag pa 'tshams dang bcas/ /bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ /yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi 'o/ /skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par rtogs par bya/ /gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du/ /shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum/ /shes pa khyad par byed pa ste/ /ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / /'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang / /sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang / /de bsdus pa dang phyir bltas dang / /mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang / /chen por gyur dang tshad med dang / /rnam shes bstan du med pa dang / /sems bltar med dang shes pa dang / /g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang / /de las gzhan yang de dag ni/ /de bzhin nyid kyi

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 31rnam par shes/ /thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs de/ /gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya ste/ /thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin/ /stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang / /smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang / /skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang / /chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang / /'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog /rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la/ /lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed/ /de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas/ /gnas dang gus par bya ba dang / /bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang / /de la mchod dang byed med dang / /kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang / /ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang / /'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang / /brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad/ /bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston/ /'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni/ /shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis/ /khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can/ /skad gcig ma ni bstodrug gis/ /khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ /bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang / /gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das/ /'phags pa kun sdud mkhas pa yis/ /rig bya thun mong min shes nyid/ /shes myur bri dang gang med dang / /sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang / /dmigs pa rten dang bcas pa dang / /mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang / /ro myang med dang khyad par ni/ /bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste/ /gang gis lam ni gzhan dag las/ /khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam/ /phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang / /mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang / /gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni/ /yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang / /lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyi/ /'bras bu mngon sum mi byed dang / /mtha' ma rten gyi mdzad pa

32 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/ste/ /'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag /dben dang dka' dang nges pa dang / /ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang / /mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang / /dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang / /mi mthun thogs pa med dang de/ /gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang / /de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang / /ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid/ /mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na/ /mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin/ /mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ /yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni/ /rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la/ /thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang / /spyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang / /bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang / /chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du/ /shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis/ /rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed/ /dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /sems can thams cad yin par bsngags/ /de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs/ /rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing / /sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan/ /de dag la ni 'god pa dang / /bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid/ /rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni/ /rang gzhan rten can bden shes pa/ /chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams/ /smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya/ /nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste/ /mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas/ /de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags/ /rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis/ /nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di/ /gzugs la sogs las ldog pa

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 33dang / /the tshom mi ngal zad pa dang / /bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing / /gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang / /gzhan gyi rten can spyin sogs dang / /zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med/ /byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang / /bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang / /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang / /gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang / /lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung / /gya gyu med sems sbyang ba dang / /len dang ser sna med sogs dang / /chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang / /sems can don du dmyal 'tshol dang / /gzhan gyis dkri bar mi btub dang / /lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la/ /bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang / /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste/ /rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis/ /drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang / /chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang / /shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i/ /mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya/ /gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang / /sems brtan theg pa dman dag las/ /rnam ldog bsam gtan la sogs pa'i/ /yan lag yongs su zad pa dang / /lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni/ /'dod pa spyod la thabs mkhas dang / /rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang / /'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang / /phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang / /tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi/ /g.yul 'gyed ser sna la sogs la/ /sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi/ /gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang / /chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid/ /rang gi sa la nges pa nyid/ /sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang / /chos kyi don du srog gtong ba/ /de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni/ /blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin/ /sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste/ /zab

34 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/mo stong pa nyid la sogs/ /zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang / /skur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid/ /nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i/ /lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la/ /yang dang yang du sems pa dang / /'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam/ /de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams/ /chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis/ /rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do/ /grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams/ /dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin/ /kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse ba'i/ /rgyu mthun de dag thub pas bzhed/ /dngos po brjod du med pa la/ /nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung / /sgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig 'thob/ /byang chub ji lta de bzhin du/ /'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed/ /byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid/ /de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed/ /sems ni snga mas byang chub bar/ /rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin/ /mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni/ /zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad/ /skye ba dag ni 'gag pa dang / /de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang / /shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang / /thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid/ /chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir/ /srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa/ /las med la sogs klan ka yi/ /lan ni ji skad bshad par zad/ /sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du/ /snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa/ /de la dag par bsgrubs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid/ /yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni/ /dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang / /mi gnas ji bzhin shugs dang ni/ /thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang / /ma chags pa dang mi dmigs dang / /mtshan ma smon lam zab pa dang / /de yi rtags dang tshad med pa/ /thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 35rgyan zhes bya ba las/ rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs/ /rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs/ /rnam mang du ni dper mdzad nas/ /rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi/ /yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa/ /sems can don yongs mi gtong ba/ /brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang / /stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas/ /bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni/ /ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la/ /gzung ba'i rnam rtog so sor de/ / dgu yi bdag nyid ji bzhin yul/ /min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya/ /so so'i skye bo 'phags dbye bas/ /sems can rdzas dang btags yod par/ /rnam rtog 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod/ /de dag so sor dgu bdag nyid/ /gal te gzung don de bzhin nyid/ /de dag gang gi 'dzin par 'dod/ /de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi/ /ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni/ /lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang / /shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang / /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang / /rang gis rtogs dang byed pa dang / /de yi las bya'i 'bras bu la/ /'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi/ /rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod/ /srid dang zhi bar lhung ba'i phyir/ /rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni/ /yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang / /lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang dang/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang / /ched du bya ba log pa dang / /

36 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/nyi tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid/ /gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang / /rjes la 'gro zhes bya ba la/ /rnam rtog dgu yi bdag nyid 'di/ /ldog pa'i phyogs kyi rten can te/ /nyan thos la sogs yid las byung / /'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang / /yid la byed dang khams rnams ni/ /gsum po dag dang nyer 'brel dang / /gnas dang mngon par zhen pa dang / /chos kyi dngos po btags pa dang / /chags pa dang ni gnyen po dang / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro nyams la/ /'dzin pa dang por shes par bya/ /ched bzhin nges par mi 98/nga dang / /lam la lam min nges 'dzin dang / /'gog dang bcas pa'i skye ba dang / /dngos po ldan dang mi ldan dang / /gnas dang rigs ni 'jig pa dang / /don du gnyer dang rgyu med dang / /phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa la/ /'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no/ /byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang / /de yi rgyu ni yongs gtong dang / /de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu/ /bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid do/ /dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i/ /ye shes byang chub ces brjod de/ /zad med skye med phyir de dag /go rim bzhin du shes par bya/ /'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad/ /skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob/ /gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ /shes bya la yang ston pa yi/ /sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang / /de la kho bos mtshar du rtsis/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /spyin pa la sogs re rer ni/ /de dag phan tshun bsdus pa gang / /skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis/ /bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam/ /de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 37lugs mthun dang / /lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed/ /'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ /rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas/ /'dod par gtogs pa'i rnam par shes/ /mnyam bzhag min pa'i mtshams bzung ste/ /thod rgal de ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /gcig dang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga/ /drug dang bdun dang brgyad brgal nas/ /'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro /mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis/ /btang bas yongs su ma bzung dang / /dus gsum yon tan med pa dang / /legs pa'i lam ni rnam gsum la/ /gzung ba'i rnam rtog 'di gcig ste/ /sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can/ /gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams/ /'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de/ /sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi/ /snying po yid la mi byed dang / /theg pa dman pa yid byed dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid mi byed/ /sgom dang sgom pa med pa dang / /de dag las ni bzlog nyid dang / /ji bzhin don min rnam rtog pa/ /sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya/ /sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang / /chos btags pa dang stong min nyid/ /chags dang rab 'byed bdag nyid dang / /dngos por byed dang theg gsum dang / /yon ni dag pa ma yin dang / /spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la/ /'dzin par byed pa deng po de/ /shes par bya ba bsgrags pa yin/ /sems can btags dang de rgyu yi/ /yul can de yis rnam 'joms pas/ /sgom pa'i lam dang 'brel ba yi/ /mi mthun phyogs gzhan rnam pa dgu/ /bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni/ /gsum gyi sgrib pa rnam gsum dang / /zhi lam de bzhin nyid sogs dang / /mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan dang / /mi mnyam sdug bsngal la sogs dang / /nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / /gnyis su med la kun rmongs la/ /rnam par rtog pa mtha' mar

38 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/bzhed/ /yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni/ /yun ring lon nas dbugs phyin ltar/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi/ /bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun/ /rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin/ /'bras bu mchog gis spa ba yi/ /sems dpa' chen po de la ni/ /rnam pa kun tu rten par byed/ /stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang / /bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med la/ /bkod pa'i dge ba dper mdzad nas/ /bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de/ /bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid/ /'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ /bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed/ /rnam pa zhi nyid 'di la ni/ /rab tu smra rnams rgyud mar rgol/ /dmigs pa 'thad dang 'di yi ni/ /ngo bo nyid nges gzung ba dang / /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes dang / /dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob dang / /sbyor dang dkon mchog gsum po dang / /thabs bcas thub pa'i rtogs pa dang / /phyin ci log ni lam bcas dang / /gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang / /mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la/ /smra ba rnams kyi log rtog pa/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid brten can/ /rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// //sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang / /sangs rgyas la sogs dran dang chos/ /dngos med ngo bo nyid kyis de/ /mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// //

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 39sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang / /zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir/ /thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi/ /rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya/ /ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud/ /rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na/ /thams cad cig car 'gul ba ltar/ /skad cig gcig shes de bzhin no/ /gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes/ /de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes/ /sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis/ /chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas/ /chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa nyid/ /skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs/ /rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid/ /gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar/ /chos rnams gnyis su med pa yi/ /de nyid skad cig gcig gis mthong / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni/ /snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang / /zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang / /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ /rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang / /nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang / /mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang / /dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang / /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang / /bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum dang / /dran pa nyer gzhag rnam gsum dang / /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang / /bag chags

40 rje btsun byams pa mgon po/yang dag bcom pa dang / /skye la thugs rje chen po dang / /thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang / /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta/ /mi yi nyon mongs yongs spong nyid/ /grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams/ /rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med/ /sangs rgyas smon nas mkhyen pa ni/ /lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang / /thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang / /'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed/ /rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur na/ /gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la de snang ngo / /lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrung ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur kyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong / /de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod/ /de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir/ /rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang / /phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang / /sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang / /zhabs 'bur mi mngon spru ni gyen du phyogs/ /byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog /pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang / /spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang / /zhal mdzod spu brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra/ /'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ /'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang / /sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab/ /gtsug gtor dbur ldan ljags

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 41ring mdzes pa dang / /tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems/ /shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang / /grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang / /spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /'di la mtshan ni gang gang gi /sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin/ /de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas/ /mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub/ /bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang / /yang dag blangs pa brtan pa dang / /bsdu ba bsten dang gya nom pa'i/ /dngos po sbyin dang gsad bya ba/ /thar par byed dang dge ba ni/ /yang dag blangs pa spel la sogs/ /sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de/ /mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang / /mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang / /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang / /seng ge glang chen bya dang ni/ /khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang / /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/ /byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang / /gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang / /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang / /shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang / /yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang / /gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang / /sku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang / /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang / /kun nas lta na sdug pa dang / /kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /sme ba gnag bag med pa dang / /phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang / /phyag ris mdangs yod zab ring dang / /zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang / /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang / /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang / /dmar dang 'brug gi sgra

42 rje btsān byams pa mgon po/nyid dang / /gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum/ /rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang / /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang / /mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ /spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang / /smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang / /snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang / /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang / /nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang / /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang / /dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang / /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang / /stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang / /mi gshor dri zhim skyes bu yi/ /yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang / /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ /gang gis srid pa ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ /'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni/ /bsdu rnam bzhi la dgod pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi/ /rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang / /sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi/ /don dang pha rol phyin drug dang / /sangs rgyas lam dang rang bzhin gyis/ /stong pa nyid dang gnyis zad dang / /brda dang dmigs pa med pa dang / /lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ni/ /mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang / /byang chub thob dang sangs rgyas zhing / /rnam par dag dang nges pa dang / /sems cad don ni tshad med dang / /sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan dang / /byang chub yan lag lam rnams ni/ /chud mi za dang bden mthong dang / /phyin ci log ni spangs pa dang / /de gzhi med pa'i tshul dang ni/ /rnam par byang dang tshogs dang ni/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa la/ /tha dad yongs su mi shes dang / /mya ngan 'das la dgod pa ste/ /

sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan/ 43chos kyi sku yi 'phrin las ni/ /rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba las/chos sku'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// //mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang / /de rab de yi go rim dang / /de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni/ /don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug /yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang / /chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni/ /donabasdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon pa rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo dang mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa lung gi don rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ smra ba rnams kyi mchog thams cad mkhyen pa de la g.yo dang zol med pas lan cig min par phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs par bshad pa'i rnga chen kun dga'i sgra/ /kun khyab dpal mo'i khyon du cher bsgrags pa'i/ / yid can 'di kun ngang gis 'dun mdzad pa'i/ /kun mkhyen lha yi lha de rtag par rgyal/ / mkhyen ldan thugs rje'i stobs kyi dpung tshogs kyis/ /rmongs shing khros pa'i mi bsrun dpung gi sde/ /mtha' dag phyogs kyi pha mthar sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan bdud kyi bdud des 'gro 'di srungs/ /thub bstan chu bo stong phrag sdud mdzad cing / /lung dang rigs pa'i chu klung 'bum phrag gis/ /'gro 'di rgud pa sel la brtson gyur pa/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon mdzod cig /de las rgyud pa'i gzhung lugs sgrol mang gis/ /gang blo'i gting mtha' yangs par ngal gso ba/ /

46 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/de las yum gyi lus dang yan lag bcas/ /gzhung gzhan legs bshad kyis brgyan 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni yum gyi lus brgyad dang / yan lag bdun cur grags pa dang / de dag gi nying lag so so'i mtshan nyid dang / rab tu dbye ba dang / sa mtshams dang bcas pa rags pa tsam zhig yin la/ 'di la thog mar bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ bshad pa nyid nye bar 'god pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i mdo gang yin pa dang /rgyan la srol 'byed du zhig yod pa dang / srol 'byed de las gang gi rjes su 'brangs pa dang garna/ma/dang po ni/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum dang / khri brgyad stong pa dang /sdud pa dang lnga ni rgyan gyi bshad bya'i gtso bo yin te chen po rnams kyis mdo de dag dang rgyan dngos su sbyar ba'i bshad pa mdzad la/ gzhan dang dngos su ma sbyar ba'i phyir/ de ltar mdzad pa yang yin te/ 'phags pa rnam par grol ba'i sde dang /btsun pa rnam grol sde dang / bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba'i sras po seng ge bzang po rnams kyis nyi khri dang rgyan sbyar/ slob dpon nyid dang shan+ti pa dang 'jigs med gsum gyis brgyad stong pa dang rgyan sbyar/ yang slob dpon nyid dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ kha che dharma shri rnams kyis sdud pa dang rgyan sbyar/ yang slob dpon nyid kyi 'grel chung dang / kha che dharma shris mdzad par grags pa'i stong phrag brgya pa'i bshad pa dang / smri ti dz+nya nas mdzad par grags pa'i yum gsum mthun par don brgyad kyis ston pa ste/ gsum po des 'bum dang yang mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 47sbyar ba'i phyir/ de ltar na mdo dang rgyan sbyar ba'i 'grel ba bcu gsum mo/ /gnyis pa rgyan la srol 'byed du zhig yod pa ni/ mdo phyogs re ba'i dgongs 'grel du bkral ba dang / yum gsum char gyi dgongs 'grel du bkral ba gnyis/dang po ni/ 'phags pa dang btsun pa'i 'grel ba lta bu yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon dang de'i rjes 'jug gis mdzad pa'i 'grel ba rnams so/ /yang rnam par rig pa tsam gyi tshul la brten pa'i srol 'byed dang / ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i tshul la brten pa'i srol 'byed gnyis kyang yod la/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang shan+ti pas mdzad pa'i 'grel ba rnams yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags seng dang 'jigs med kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel ba rnams yin no/ /khyad par du 'grel ba don gsal 'di'i phyogs dang mthun zhing rjes su 'jug pa'i 'grel ba ni brgyad de/ don gsal 'di nyid kyi 'grel bshad tshig gsal zhes grags pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / rtogs dka'i snang ba zhes grags pa gser gling pas mdzad pa dang / 'grel chung gi bsdus don du grags pa sher 'byung blo gros kyis mdzad pa dang / jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa'i bsdus don sgron me dang /kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i bsdus don dang / rat+na kirtis mdzad pa'i 'grel ba grags pa'i cha zhes pa dang / bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa'i shes rab sgron ma'i phreng ba dang / 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i thub pa'i dgongs rgyan rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ bshad pa'i srol de dag las rgyal sras chen po bzang po'i zhabs kyi 'grel ba don gsal du ji ltar bkral ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i phyir te/slob dpon 'dis ni rje btsun nyid la dngos su snang ba thob nas yum don dbu mar

48 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/bkral zhing yum gsum ga'i rgyan du sbyar bas lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa la/ gus pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ gzhan bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang sras 'phags pa la phan 'dogs byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ rang sras 'phags pa'i yum tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ zag med kyi phung po skyed byed kyi yum dang / bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po gsar du skrun byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po skyed byed kyi yum gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ brtse ba snying rje chen po/ bsam gtan te bzhi/ de'i nang nas shes rab ni yum mtshan nyid pa yin la/ gzhan gsum ni zag med kyi phung po skyed byed mtshan nyid pa dang yum btags pa ba yin no/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa de/ bzhed don sgrub nus kyi yum mam/ 'dir bstan mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ yum gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen dang gsum/ rang sras theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ yum gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni gzhi shes mtha' dag la bya/ de yang theg dman gyi gzhi shes ni theg dman gyi bzhed don dngos su sgrub byed yin la/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes ni brgyud nas bzhed don sgrub byed yin no/ /'dir

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 49theg dman gyi bzhed don ni/ theg dman gyi nyer zhi gnyis yin la/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ma lus par spangs shing / nyon mongs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang bcas pa'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de/ dman pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sku tshe'i 'du byed ma btang ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi so sor brtags 'gog lta bu la bya/nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ma lus par spangs shing / nyon mongs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang bral ba'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de/ dman pa'i lhag med myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba'i brtags 'gog lta bu'o/ /rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ yum lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni lam shes mtha' dag la bya/ de la byang sems kyi rgyud kyi lam she sa kyis ni byang sems kyi bzhed don dngos su sgrub/ sangs rgyas kyi lam shes kyis ni byang sems kyi bzhed don brgyud nas sgrub par byed do/ /'dir byang sems kyi bzhed don ni gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba blangs pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten gyi don sgrub par mdzad pa'o/ /rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ yum rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rnam mkhyen tsam la bya'o/ /de yang rnam mkhyen rjes mthun pas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don brgyud nas sgrub par byed la/rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pas ni dngos su sgrub par byed do/ /sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don ni gzhan don du chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba de yin/de la mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig rang gi mi mthun phyogs gcod par byed pa de/

50 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ lung gi chos 'khor dang / rtogs pa'i chos 'bor gnyis/ dang po la/ rtogs pa'i chos gsar brjod byar ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/de la dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ bka' dang po dang / bar pa dang / mtha' ma dang gsum/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can la gtso bor gsungs shing / dus dang por gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' de/ bka' dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dul ba lung sde bzhi lta bu la zer/ de yang rtsa ba'i lung ni dge slong pha'i so sor thar pa'i mdo dang / dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i mdo la bya/ bshad pa'i lung ni/ rnam par 'byed pa dang / gzhi dang / phran tshegs dang / gzhung dam pa'o/ /de dag gi gzhung tshad ni/gzhi la bam po brgya dang dgu /rnam 'byed gya gsum phran tshegs la/ /nga dgu gzhung ngam lnga bcu lnga / /zhes pa'o/ /gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can la gtso bor gsungs shing / dus bar du gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lta bu la byace(/ /gdul bya sna chosags la gsungs shing /dus mtha' mar gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' de/ bka' mtha' ma'i mtshan nyid/ de ni mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel lta bu la bya'o/ /yang lung gi chos 'khor la brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'bor

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 51dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi brjod bya gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab/ 'di la dbye na/ bka' dang po/ bar pa/mtha' ma dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dul ba lung lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bden pa bzhi gtso bor ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo'i cha shas lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bden pa bzhi gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i bka' mtha' ma'i cha shas 'ga' zhig lta bu la bya'o/ /rnam thar sgo gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la yang bka' dang po dang /bar pa dang / mtha' ma gsum/ dang po ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i 'dul ba lung gi cha shas 'ga' zhig lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ stong nyid brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i bka' mtha' ma'i cha shas 'ga' zhig lta bu'o/ /kun btags/ gzhan dbang / yongs grub gsum du phye nas gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de// legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la yang bka' dang po dang / bar pa dang / mtha' ma dang gsum ste/ de yang rim bzhin du/ de ltar phye nas ston pa'i 'dul ba lung gi cha shas 'ga' zhig dang / de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang / /zhes pa'i skabs kyi sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu dang / gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /de ltar na bka' dang po dang / bar pa dang / tha ma gsum po re re la yang bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ legs par rnam par phye pa'i chos 'khor te gsum gsum du phye bas dgur rig par bya'o/ /yang lung gi chos 'bor la drang nges kyi sgo nas dbye na/ drang don gyi mdo dang /nges don gyi mdo rnam pa gnyis/ gdul bya theg pa chen po'i rigs can la stong nyid

52 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu'o/ /sher phyin gyi mdo'i cha shas su gyur pa'i drang jo/na gyi mdo yang yod de/ gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can la gtso bor kun rdzob bden pa brjod byar ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo'i cha shas 'ga' zhig yod nga 'i phyir/ de yang dper na// slob ma bse ru'i lam gang zhes pa'i skabs kyi mdo lta bu dang / yul nges pa dang zhes pa'i skabs kyi mdo lta bu'o/ /gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba'i don du kun rdzob bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dul ba lung sde bzhi lta bu la bya'o/ /de'i cha shas su gyur pa'i nges don gyi mdo med pa min te/ de'i cha shar+sā su gyur pa'i rme tshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor yod pa'i phyir/ de dag ni brjod bya'i sgo nas drang nges su bzhag pa yin la/ 'dir ni de nyid khas len no / /skabs gzhan du ni rjod byed kyi sgo nas drang nges su bzhag pa/ gdul bya'i sgo nas drang nges su bzhag pa/ grub mtha'i sgo nas drang nges su bzhag pa yang yod de/dang po ni/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de ni dgongs pa can dang ldem por dgongs pa'i mdo rnams la zer/ drang don gyi mdo gang zhig dgongs gzhi gtso bor ston pa de/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mnyamatshopa nyid la dgongs pa/ dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ don gzhan la dgongs pa/ gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa bzhi/drang don gyi mdo gang zhig dgos pa gtso bor ston pa de/ ldem dgongs kyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa/ sgyur ba ldem por

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 53dgongs pa/ mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa/ gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa dang bzhi/ dgongs ldem dgongs kyi mdo gnyis 'gal ba ni min te/ dgongs pa can bzhi ka gnyen po ldem dgongs kyi nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/drang nges kyi bshad tshul gnyis pa la/ gdul bya gtso bor lam la gzhug pa'i phyir du gsungs pa'i mdo de drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ gduspru bya gtso bor lam gyi 'bras bu la gzhug pa'i phyir du gsungs pa'i mdo de nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/drang nges kyi bshad tshul gsum pa la/ grub mtha' rang lugs kyi nges don mthar thug ston pa'i mdo yin yang / grub mtha' gong ma la ltos te drang don gyi mdor bzhag dgos pa de/ drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sems tsam pa gtso bor 'dod pa'i mdo lta bu la zer/ de ltar bzhag mi dgos pa'i mdo de/ nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid/ de ni dbu ma pa gtso bor 'dod pa'i mdo lta bu la bya'o/ /yang lung gi chos 'bor la rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dul ba'i sde snod/mdo sde'i sde sdod/ mngon pa'i sde snod dang gsum/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnam dag gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni /lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa brjod bya 'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnam dag gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnam dag de'i mtshan gzhi ni bye brag tu smra bas mngon pa sde bdun lta bu la 'dod la/ sde bdun ni/chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /

54 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo'u 'gal bus/ /ye shes la 'jug ka ta'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig shes kyis/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po chos/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos bsdus/ /zhes pa'o/ /mdo sde pa ltar na/ mngon pa'i sde snod zhes bya ba po ti dang glegs bam logs su byas pa med kyi/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde'i nang nas chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i gsung rab sil bur gnas pa gang yin pa de'o zhes zer ro/ /rnal 'byor dpyod pa ba na re/ chos mngon pa'i mdo stong phrag brgya pa lta bu la 'dod do/ /yang gdul bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod dang / theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod gnyis/ theg pa chen po'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na mdo sde sa bcu pa lta bu/ theg pa chen po kho na'i lam 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa lung phyogs re ba dang /theg pa gsum ka'i lam 'bras kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par ston pa sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu gzhung rgyas pa gnyis yod do/ /gtso bor theg pa chung ngu'i lam 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i mdo de/ theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mdo sde dran pa nyer gzhag lta bu'o/ /rang sangs rgyas la ni sde snod logs pa med de/ de ni

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 55sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du mi 'byung bas de'i phyir du gsungs pa'i sde snod la sogs pa med la/ nyan thos kyi sde snod gcig nyid la thos bsam sgom gsum rim pas sbyangs pa na dbang po'i rim pas nyan rang gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang lung gi chos 'khor la sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ de yang snying po mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la phab pa'o /zhes byung ba ltar ro/ /de yang mdo'i sde la sogs pa dang po lnga ni theg pa thun mong gi mdo sde'i sde snod yin la/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang rmad du byung ba'i sde gnyis ni byang chub sems dpa'i thun mong min pa'i mdo sde'i sde snod yin no/ /gleng gzhi'i sde/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde dang gsum ni theg pa thun mong gi 'dul ba'i sde snod yin la/ skyes pa'i rabs kyi sde ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod yin no/ /gtan la phab pa'i sde ni mngon pa'i sde snod du gtogs so/ /yang bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lang kar potagags pa lta bu sangs rgyas nyid kyis zhal nas gsungs pa dang / gnyis pa

56 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ni/ shes rab snying po lta bu gzhan la byin gyis brlabs nas gsung du bcug pa dang / gsum pa ni/ mdo rnams kyi gleng gzhi dang mtshams sbyor lta bu ste/ de yang sangs rgyas nyid kyis bka' bsdu ba po rnams la rjes su gnang ba yin no/ /yang lung gi chos 'khor la dgos pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen po ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong / de yang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong / zhe sdang gi gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong / gti mug gi gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong / dug gsum gyi gnyen por cha mnyam du ston pa nyi khri chig stong /chos phung gi tshad ni kha cig na re/ sho lo ka drug stong la bya ba yin te/ shā ri'i bus byas pa'i bstan bcos kyi phung po de chos phung gcig gi tshad du byas shing / de la sho lo ka drug stong gi tshad du yod pa'i phyir zhes zer/ kha cig na re/ brjod bya sde tshan re re tshang bar ston nus pa'i ming tshig ye ge'i tshogs la chos phung gi tshad du byed pa dang / kha cig gis ni nyon mongs pa sna re 'jo mas nus pa'i gnyen po ston nus pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams chos phung gcig gi tshad du byed ces zer la/theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyis glang po che sa la rab brtan gyis khur bar nus pa'i snag tshas chos phung gcig 'bri bar nus so zhes zer la/ 'di dag ni tshad lda na gyi gzhung 'ga' zhig las gsungs pa yin no/ /yang lung gi chos 'khor la dngos btags ma phye ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rjes mthun pa bka'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ spobs pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'i mtshan nyid/ spobs pa bzhi ni/ brjod bya don

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 57mthun pa/ rjod byed ngag tshig dri ma med pa dang 'brel ba/ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa spong ba/ 'bras bu zhi ba'i phan yon ston pa'o/ /de skad du yang /gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin /zhes rber+sha/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i ngag de/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mtshan nyid pa nang pa'i bstan bcos dang / rjes mthun pa phyi nang thun mong ba'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yengs med pa'i yid can gyis thar pa thob pa'i thabs su bka'i don bshad pa'i ngag de la dbye na/ don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos/ sgrub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ yang na sa sde lnga lta bu 'khrugs pa go rim du sdeb par byed pa'i bstan bcos/ tshad ma kun las btus pa lta bu 'thor ba sdud par byed pa'i bstan bcos/mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu rgya chen po sdud par byed pa'i bstan bcos/ rig pa'i gnas dang po bzhi gtso bor ston cing rtsom pa po tshad ldan gyis mdzad pa'i ngag de/ thun mong ba'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ don med pa'i bstan bcos/ don log pa'i bstan bcos/ thos pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ ngan g.yo'i bstan bcos/ brtse bral gyi bstan bcos/

58 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ji skad du/don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces so/ /yang na sgra'i bstan bcos/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos/ bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid ni/ ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig bshad cing nyams su blangs pas gdul bya'i rgyud la 'pho bar snang ba/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'gog pa'i bden pa dang / lam gyi bden pa gnyis/ dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ bka' dang po dang / bar pa dang / mtha' ma gsum/ rdzod byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/ bden bzhi'i chos 'khor la sogs pa gsum/ mi mthun phyogs spong tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la sogs pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa dgos 'brel la/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos sogs chos bzhi dang / bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi/ dang po la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ dgos 'brel ngag la brten nas bstan bcos 'di la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod dam snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyes pa de dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa/ de la brten nas bstan bcos 'di la thos bsam gyi

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 59zhugs pa de dbostas 'brel ngag gi nying datre/sa/ phyi ma snga ma la rag las pa 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dam/ yang na 'phags pa bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya/ bstan bcos 'di la brten nas de bde blag tu rtogs pa de dgos pa/ chos kyi sku mngon du byas pa de nying dgos/ phyi ma snga ma la rag las pa de 'brel ba'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ dbye gzhi sher phyin ngos bzung ba dang / dbye ngo mngon par rtogs pa brgyad yan lag dang bcas pa ngakhrind pace( / /dang po la/ rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum de sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/brjod bya yul gyi sher phyin dang / de ston byed yul can gyi sher phyin gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ so so rang gis rig pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa'i de kho na nyid de/ snying po don gyi sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i de kho na nyid lta bu la bya'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni /don dam rtogs pa'i ye shes sam/ de brjod byar ston pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba de/ ston byed yul can gyi sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/rgyu'i sher phyin dang / 'bras bu'i sher phyin gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sher phyin gyi ming gis 'dogs rung gang zhig 'bras yum gyi sar sgrod byed du gyur ba de/rgyu'i she ra phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzhung sher phyin dang / lam sher phyin gnyis/ snying po don gyi sher phyin nam lam sher phyin gang rung brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i gsung rab rnam dag de/ gzhung sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sher phyin gyi mdo'am/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu la zer/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye

60 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/shes chos bzhi ldan de/ lam sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos bzhi ni/shes rab mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ni theg chen gyi lam lnga'am/ rgyu'i dbang du byas na lam dang po bzhi la brjod do/ /chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo gang zhig srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol tu son pa de/ 'bras bu sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa bshad bya la mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bshad pa dang / 'chad byed don bdun cu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab 'khor bcas de mngon par rtogs pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen la rnam mkhyen tsam dang / skabs dang po'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ bden gnyis kyi rnam pa ma lus pa thugs su chud pa'i mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ de la dbye na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes gang zhig skabs dang por 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'o/ /sa mtshams la/ mtshan nyid pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod/ rjes mthun pa ni slob lam na yang yod/

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 61gnyis pa lam shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ de la shes rab kyi khyad par ni lam gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas yar ldan du rgyud la bskyed par mkhas pa/ thabs kyi khyad par rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas kyi bar du yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed cing gzhan gyi don byed pa/'dir nyan rang gi spangs rtogs rdzogs pa'i sa mtshams/ rdzogs smin sbya nga gsum byas pa'i tshad/ yang dag mtha'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i byang sems kyis mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod nas nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs pa yin te/ de nas nyan rang dgra bcom pas ji tsam spangs pa de tsam zhig spangs zhing / ji cam rtogs pa de tsam rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la smon lam rdzogs pa'i tshad ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'thob par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam grub pa'o/ /sems can smin pa'i tshad ni/ sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams sgrib pa spang rung dang gnyen po skye rung gi nus pa mthu can du byas pa'o/ /zhing sbyangs pa'i tshad ni/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba bsgom pa'i nus pa mthar thug pa'o/ /yang dag mtha'i ngos 'dzin ni de bzhin nyid la bya'o/ /bye brag tu skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ lam shes gang zhig 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu'i cha nas gtso bor bstan pa/ de ni byang sems kyi lam shes kho na la bya/ de la dbye na/ dmigs yul theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas rnam pa gsum mo/ /gsum pa gzhi shes la gzhi shes tsam dang / skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i
