112 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gsum gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe bya ba ngan zhen dang / sgyid lug pa dang / bdag nyid la brnyas pa'i le lo de gsum gyi gnyen por brtson 'grus gsum don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de/ 'dir bstan gyi brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la/ lus ngag gi spyod pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas de la ma chags pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ sgyid lug pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag nyid la brnyas shing zhum pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/lnga pa spyan dang mngon shes la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la/ dngos dang /yul spyan dang / mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe 'bras bu spyan dang mngon shes la mngon par zhen pa med par sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de/ 'dir bstan gyi de'i mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la spyan bshad pa dang / mngon shes bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten cing rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas rang

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 113yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i rig pa de/ 'dir bstan spyan gyi mtshan nyid/de la dbye na lnga las/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi skyon sbyang ba'i sha'i mig dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum gyi bar gang rung mthong ba'i yul can de/ sha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mthong ba'i yul can gyi rig pa de/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas/ chos thams cad la cir yang mi rtog pa'i rig pa de/ shes rab kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi de dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chod kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can gyi rig pa de/chos kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi dang thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i yul can gyi rig pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams la/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam/ gnyis pa ni sbyor lam/gsum pa ni byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag bzhi pa ni byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob/ lnga pa mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod cing / rjes mthun pa sa bdun pa na yang yod do/ /

114 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gnyis pa mngon shes la/ rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i rig pa de mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sa g.yo ba la sogs par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi de'i mtshan nyid/ yang de la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i sgra chung ngu dang cig shos thos par nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin de/ lha'i rna ba'i de'i mtshan nyid/de la brten nas gzhan gyi sems la 'dod chags yod med sogs shes par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ gzhan sems shes pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs dpag tu med pa rjes su dran par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa de'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas sems can thams cad 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / de dag gi kha dog sna tshogs pa rnams mngon sum du mthong bar nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ tshe 'dir bsam gtan sgom pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/'di dang lha'i spyan gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ snga ma ni sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba yin la/ phyi ma ni tshe 'dir bsam gtan sgom pa las byung ba ni 'di'i khyad par nyi snang las bshad/ 'bum phrag gsum pa de'i steng du spyan dang mngon shes kyi sde tshan mi gcig pa dang / snga mas 'a chi 'pho dang skye ba mthong ba dang / phyi mas gzugs thams cad mthong bas yul gyi khyad par dang /khyad par gsum ldan du 'chad kyang mi 'thad de/ phyi mas kyang 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba mthong bar mdo nyid las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /sde tshan mi gcig pa ni rtsod gzhi

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 115yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan sa drug po gang rung la brten nas sgrib gnyis gang rung gi sa bon spangs pa'i rnam grol lam mam/ sbong bar byed bzhin pa'i bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/zag pa za da pa shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ skabs 'dir drug po gang rung yin na dge ba yin pas khyab ste/ mngon pa gong ma las ngo bo ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab tu bshad pa'i phyir dang / mngon pa 'og ma las/mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni/ /lung du ma bstan lhag rnams dge /zhes bya'o/ /mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen ni dbang po gzugs can pa yin la/ lhag ma bzhi ni thun mong gi bdag rkyen yid la brten pa yin no/ /sa mtshams la mngon she/sa dang po lnga ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba yin la/ drug pa ni 'phags pa thams cad la yod do/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa'i spyan dang mngon par shes pa 'di dag ni byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas pa yin par mdo las bshad do/ /drug pa sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong sgom gnyis la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la/ mthong sgom gyi lam don dam par mi dmigs shing kun rdzob tu sgrib pa'i gnyen por nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de/ 'dir bstan gyi mthong sgom gyi lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sngar bskyed pa'i gdams ngag bcu'i mtshan nyid rnams so sor 'phral nas shes par bya'o/ /

116 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gnyis pa bstan bya sgrub pa nyid bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i dang po nges 'byed yan lag bshad pa dang / sgrub pa khyad par du 'phel ba'i rim pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing chos nyid la don spyi'i tshul gyis sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs sam/ 'dir bstan gyi khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/'dir bstan gyi theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ khyad chos lnga ni/theg dman sbyor lam dang thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa la dmigs pa de dang /thun mong min pa'i rnam pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / de dang thun mong min pa'i rtogs rigs kyi rgyu byed pa dang / de dang thun mong min pa'i spang bya spong ba dang / de dang thun mong min pa'i yongs 'dzin dang ldan pa'o/ /theg dman sbyor lam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i gzhir bzung zhing theg chen sbyor lam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i gzhir ma bzung ba de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mi rtag la sogs bcu drug lta bu dang / gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med pa lta bu'o/ /sbyor lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa 'i sgo nas chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi mngon zhen med pa'i rnam pa can gyi ye shes lta bu'o/ /rang 'bras theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i ye shes lta bu la bya'o/ /theg chen sbyor lam pa theg dman du mi lhung bar theg

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 117chen du yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ theg chen sbyor lam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam dang 'dzin stangs mi 'gal ba'i 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa bzhi spong bar nus pa'i theg chen sbyor lam gyi nus pa de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i rnam rtog ldan tshul gyi khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/theg chen sbyor lam la dbye na/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/mtshan nyid ni rim pa ltar 'grel chen ltar na/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang / drod kyi ye shes rdzogs rjes su byung zhing rnam byang gi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang / rtse mo'i ye shes rdzogs rjes su gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang / bzod pa rdzogs rjes su skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa'o/ /rtsa ba dang 'grel pa don gsal 'di ltar na/dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de 'dir bstan gyi drod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ ting 'dzin de'i byed pa nyid/ /ces pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khya/ da par dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan/ gyi chos mchog gi mtshan nyid ces sbyar na legs so/ /

118 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/bye brag tu spang bya rtog pa'i rnam par bzhag pa la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod byed de/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzung rtog dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul gzung ba la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/'dir bstan kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig rnam byang gi phyogs la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan gyi rnam byang gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ 'dir bstan rtog pa gang zhig gang zag gi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i 'dzin pa la dmigs nas rdzas yod du zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i 'dzin pa la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ de ltar rtog pa sum cu so drug po de la khams gsum gyi dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad du yang 'gyur ro/ /'dir bstan gyi

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 119spang bya rtog pa la sbong byed gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye na/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtog pa dang / sgom spang du gyur pa'i rtog pa gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig grub mtha'i dbang gis sgro btags pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig grub mtha' ngan pas sgro btags pa la ma ltos par lhan skyes su 'byung ba de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa lhan skyes yin na grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa kho na'i rgyud la 'byung bas ma khyab ste/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la btags 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis po re re la yang gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis gnyis su phye ba nas bzung ste brgya rtsa brgyad du dbye ba'i bar snga ma kho na bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa khyad par du 'phel ba'i rim pa bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i yan lag bshad pa dang / yan lag can sgrub pa'i dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/sgrub pa'i rten dang / dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bstan bya'i gtso bo bshad pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang gi brten chos theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gzhir gyur pa de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnas skabs kyi rten dang /mthar thug gi rten gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi rten ni sgrub pa po byang sems nyid la bya/ mthar thus/ gi rten ni byang sems de'i rgyud kyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la bya'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de la ngo bo gcig cing ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang / sems kyi chos dbyings rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur la/ de gnyis dbyer med pa la rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya zhing / 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang / chos

120 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/nyid dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi de la sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /'di la rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ brten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum gyis dbye bas bcu gsum mo/ /bcu gsum ni/ rtogs pa'i chos drug gi sgrub pa drug gnyen po'i sgrub pa/ spong ba'i sgrub pa/ de dag yongs su gtugs pa'i sgrub pa/ shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa/ gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub pa/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang bcu gsum yin la/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi dang / mthong lam dang / sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam rnams la rtogs pa'i chos drug gi sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam la gnyen po'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa brgyad pa'i nyon sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la spong ba'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ 'dir spangs pa dang spong ba don gcig pa yin te/ dper na spong ba chen po bzhin no/ /sa brgyad pa'i shes sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la de dag yongs su gtugs pa'i bsgrub pa zhes bya/ sa dgu pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa dgu pa'i khyad par gyi lam la thun mong min pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes la gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes la ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ de ltar na/ rang gi brten chos theg chen sbyor lam drod kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi drod kyi sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas rang gi rten chos rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid kyi bar du sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 121gnyis pa de las 'phros nas rigs kyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ bye brag tu smra bas sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa de/rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnas mal dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang gsum/ spong ba dang sgom pa la mngon par dga' ba ste 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir 'dod do/ /mdo sde pas zag pa med pa'i sems kyi sa bon byang chub 'byung rung gi nus pa de la/ rigs kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod do/ /sems tsam pa la lugs gnyis las/phyogs kyi glang pos/ sems byung brtse ba dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin la rigs su 'dod do/ /thogs med sku mched kyi lugs la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'am yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i steng gi rang 'bras byang chub 'byung rung gi nus pa thog ma med pa'i dus can zhig la 'dod do/ /'di la ming gi rnam grangs ni skyes mched drug gi khyad par/ thos pa'i bag chags/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon zhes bya/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs ni/ gsar du yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i byang chub 'thob rung gi nus pa'o/ /mdor na grub mtha' smra ba de gsum gyis rigs la dngos pos khyab par 'dod do/ /mdor na sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs de nyid/rkyen gyi nus pas brtas par byas pa na rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs zhes bya ba yin te/ rgya mtsho sprin las/ rigs de nyid gnas skabs kyi khyad par gzhan du gyur pa las ming gzhan gyi bstan pa ni yang dag par sgrub pa zhes bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na rigs chad pa'i sems can dang / ma chad pa'i sems can gnyis/

122 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rigs ma chad pa la rigs nges pa dang / ma nges pa gnyis/ nges pa la nyan thos su rigs nges pa/ rang rgyal du rigs nges pa/ sangs rgyas su rigs nges pa dang gsum du sems tsam pas bzhed do/ /sems tsam pas chos dbyings rigs btags pa bar bzhed pa'i skabs kyang yod do/ /mngon pa kun las btus las/ci'i phyir chos kyi dbyings zhes bya zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rgyu yi phyir zhes pa dang / dbus mtha' las kyang de bzhin du bshad do / /dbu ma'i lugs la/ rigs bshad pa dang / zhar la bde gshegs snying po ngos gzung ba gnyis/ gnas gyur pa na byang chub tu 'gyur du rung ba de/ spyir rigs tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / brten chos kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis so/ /dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin gang zhig blo bur gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi skur 'gyur du rung ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings dang / dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gnyis/ dang po/ blo bur gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung yin phyir/ chos nyid rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya/ phyi ma yang sems kyi rang bzhin yin pa gang zhig gnas gyur pa na ye shes kyi skur 'gyur rung yin phyir/ chos can rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya/ gsar du yang dag par sgrub pa'i dge rtsa gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi kun rdzob pa'i skur 'gyur rung de/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 123la byed do/ /gnyis pa brten chon+da/ kyi sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rigs/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang gsum/ de re re la yang rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis gnyis su dbyer yod la/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings de la nyan thos kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya ste/ nyan thos kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gang zhig gnas gyur pa na nyan thos kyi lhag med myang 'das su 'gyur du rung ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhar la bde gshegs snying po ngos gzung ba la/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyings de/ bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ chos sku dang / de bzhin nyid dang / rigs dang rnam pa gsum mo/ /dang po chos kyi sku ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dngos yin/ de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod par bshad pa de btags pa ba yin/ gnyis pa de bzhin nyid ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang sems can gnyis ka'i snying po dngos yin la/ gnyis ka'i rgyud la yod par bshad pa de mtshan nyid pa yin/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni/sems can gyi snying po dngos yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po btags pa ba yin/ 'di la khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes kyang bya ste/ sems can gyi khams kyang yin la sangs rgyas kyi snying por yang 'gyur du rung ba'i phyir/ mdor na sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems kyi chos nyid gcig nyid dri ma dang bcas pa'i cha nas rigs dang khams zhes bya/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i cha nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i sgro 'dogs gcad

124 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/par bya ba'i dmigs pa dang / sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa gnyis/dang po la/ theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni shes bya thams cad la bya zhing / sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig dam pa rnams kyis blang bar 'os pa de/ dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na mngon pa gong ma las bcu gsum du bshad la/ 'og ma ltar na/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba/ kun slong gi dge ba/ don dam pa'i dge ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dad pa la sogs bcu gcig la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems dang sems byung la bya/ gsum pa des kun nas slong ba'i lus ngag gi las la bya/ bzhi pa ni/ de bzhin nyid la bya'o/ /lung du bstan pa gang zhig skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dor bar bya ba de/ mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/mngon pa gong ma las bcu gnyis/ 'og ma ltar na snga ma ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/'dod pa'i khams kyi 'jig mthar gnyis ma gtogs pa'i rtsa nyon rnams la bya/gnyis pa ni de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems dang sems las byung ba la bya/gsum pa des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las la bya/ bzhi pa 'ashesar ba thams cad la bya/ dge mi dge gang du yang lung bstan mi nus pa'i chos de/ lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gong ma las bcu bzhir bshad la/ 'og ma ltar na snga ma ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ khams gong gi rtsa nyon dang nye nyon/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'jig mthar lhan skyes rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i chos rnams so/ /'dir don dam pa'i dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ni btags pa ba yin no/ /yang lung ma bstan la dbye na/ sgrib pas

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 125lung ma bstan pa dang / ma sgrib pas lung ma bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs can gyi yid dang khams gong gi nyon mongs lta bu la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang nam mkha' lta bu la bya'o/ /dge ba la dbye na/ 'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa dge ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa dge ba gnyis/ so so skye bo'i sas bsdus kyi dge ba dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i sas bsdus kyi dge ba de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba la dbye na/ zag bcas kyi dge ba dang / zag med kyi dge ba gnyis su yod la/zag med kyi dge ba la yang 'dus byas lam bden dang / 'dus ma byas 'gog bden gnyis yod/ 'dus ma byas la yang thun mong ba'i yon tan dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gnyis yod do/ /'dir zag bcas dang zag med kyi don la/ mngon pa gong ma las zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ma 'brel la zag bcas dang zag med du bshad/mngon pa 'og ma las zag pa dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur mi 'gyur la de gnyis su bshad pa dang / 'phags seng gis mnyam bzhag la zag med dang / rjes thob la zag bcas su bshad pa rnams las/'dir ni mngon pa gong ma dang mthun pa yin te/ 'grel ba las bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po byed mi byed kyi sgo nas der bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /zag pa'i sgo drug ni/zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/ zag pas bcings pa/ zag pa dang rjes su 'brel ba/ zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba dang drug go /dang po ni/ rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams te/ zag pa dngos yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems sems byung rnams so/ /

126 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i zag bcas kyi las lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/kun gzhi'i steng gi zag pa snga mas phyi ma bskyed pa'i nus pa lta bu/ lnga pa ni/ gang la dmigs nas zag pa skye ba'i yul lta bu/ drug pa ni/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu/ mdor na lam gyi bden pa rnams ni zag med dang / zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu la zag bcas su bzhag go /lhag ma rnams rtogs par sla'o/ /gnyis pa ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o/ /gang gi dbang du byas nas theg chen sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i 'thob bya mthar thug de/theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/de la dbye na/ sems chen po/ sbong ba chen po/ rtogs pa chen po dang gsum/rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag de sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems bskyed de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed dang / mi 'gul ba'i sems bskyed dang / phan bde'i sems bskyed dang / chos la kun dga' ba'i sems bskyed rnams la zer ro/ /de yang 'phags pa ltar na ji skad bshad pa'i sems de rnams sems chen po yin par 'dod do/ /slob dpon ltar na/ ji skad bshad pa'i sems de rnams mdo las byang sems kyi rgyud la yod par bshad pas/ des sems chen po nyid sgrub par byed pa yin gyi sems chen po nyid ma yin par bzhed/ mdor na 'dir bstan gyi chen po gsum po de mdo'i dngos bstan la byang sems kyi rgyud la yod par bshad de/ sems dpa' chen por 'jog par byed pa'i chos su gsungs pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos las sangs rgyas kyi sar bshad de/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i 'byung sa mthar thug tu gsungs pa'i

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 127phyir/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i spangs pa mthar thug de/ spong ba chen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas sa'i spangs pa lta bu la zer/ ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya ma lus par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug de/ rtogs pa chen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lta bu la zer/ phyi ma 'di gnyis kyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag ces sbyor ba ni mdo dang mi mthun no/ /de lta na chen po dang po ni ched du bya ba spyi cam pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni spangs rtogs so sor phye ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dbye ba ston par byed pa la/ dbye gzhi dang / dbye ngo gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa tsam de rten theg chen sems bskyed la gnas nas 'bras bu byang chub chen po'i ched du rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po rtsom pa'i bya ba'o/ /de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mkhyen gsum spyi'i sgrub pa dang / sbyor bzhi bye brag gi sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul skye med gsum la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sgrub pa'o/ /de ni bshad bya dngos brgyad kyi ldog pa nas bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sgrub pa lta bu'o/ /yul can pha rol tu phyin pa drug la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'chad byed don bdun cu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa lta bu'o/ /yang na skye med gsum la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni theg chen tshogs lam pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa lta bu la bya/ 'di la sgrub pa bzhi'i dbye ba med do/ / skye med gsum la sbyor ba bzhi'i rim pas nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub pa

128 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgrub pa nas skad cig sbyor ba'i sgrub pa'i bar bzhi yod cing / go cha'i sgrub pa sogs kyang 'di las phye ba yin/ 'dir mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa bshad nas/chos sku dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa ma bshad de/ de ni 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa yin/ pa'i phyir/theg chen gyi sgrub pa la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ go cha'i sgrub pa/'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba/ sa mtshams byang sems kyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu'i bar na yod do/ /de la lus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub la sogs drug rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin de drug ldan du nyams su len pa la go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba de/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyas par phye na sum cu so drug go /zhar la phyin drug gi rnam par bzhag pa la/ srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol tu phyin par byed pa'am pha rol tu phyin pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ phar phyin tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ dang po la/ gtong ba'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan de sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang bral ba/ grogs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ byed las theg pa gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can smin par byed pa/ de la dbye na/ chos kyi spyin pa/

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 129zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi spyin/ pa dang gsum/'chal tshul spong ba'i sems byung chos bzhi ldan de/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos bzhi ni snga ma ltar sbyar ro/ /de la dbye na/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang garna/ma/rgyud mi 'khrugs pa'i sems byung chos bzhi ldan de/ bzod pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa dang gsum/dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung chos bzhi ldan de/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus dang gsum/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i chos bzhi ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin de/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan/ rtog med dpyod tsam gyi bsam gtan/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa'i bsam gtan dang gsum/chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo chos bzhi ldan de/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum mam/ yang na kun rdzob la dmigs pa'i shes rab/ don dam la dmigs pa'i she sa rab/ sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig 'jug yul theg chen la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug pa'i bya ba de/ 'jug sgrub kyi

130 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/mtshan nyid/ de la 'jug yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /zhar la 'jug yul theg chen gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ bgrod bya'am bgrod byed gang rung gang zhig chen po bdun dang ldan pa de/ 'jug yul theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu las/ dang po bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa dang / gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa las nges par 'byung ba'am/ 'byung bzhin pa'i mnyam bzhag gi sas bsdus de/ bsam gtan lha/mas 0〈cog gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na nyer bsdogs dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig rang rang gi dngos gzhi thob byed kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bor skyes pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i/ gnyis pa'i/ gsum pa'i/ bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rtog dpyod gang rung gi sgo nas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob byed kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bor skyes pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs zag med dang / dag pa ba gnyis/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs gang zhig bden pa'i rnam pa can du skyes pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs yin na/ 'das lam yin mi dgos te/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs sbyor lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams zag med do/ /bsam gtan dang

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 131po'i nyer bsdogs gang zhig zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi dge ba rtse gcig pa de/gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa/mos pa las byung ba yid la byed pa/ rab tu dben pa yid la byed pa/ dga' ba sdud pa yid la byed pa/ spyod pa yid la byed pa/ sbyor ba'i mtha' yid la byed pa dang drug go /rtog dpyod gnyen po'i yan lag gis 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po la zhi rags su lta ba'i thos bsam 'dres ma'i yid byed dang po de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rtog dpyod gang rung gi sgo nas 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po'i skyon yon la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i yid byed gnyis pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa chen po gsum spong bar byed pa'i yid byed gsum pa de/gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa 'bring po gsum sbong bar byed pa'i yid byed de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa phal cher spangs shing rang rgyud la 'dod pa'i nyon mongs yod dam med dpyod par byed pa'i yid byed de/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa chung ngu gsum spong bar byed bzhin pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i yid byed de/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/'dis nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams kyi yid byed drug gi mtshan nyid kyang rtogs par bya'o/ /yan lag gi sgo nas/ 'og sa las nges par byung zin pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'arnacog gang zhig bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs yin par 'gal ba de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /

32 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rtog dpyod gang rung gi gnyen po'i yan lag gis 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gye snyoms 'jug gang zhigadaben pa las skyes pa'i dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/dbye na/dngos gzhi tsam po dang /dngos gzhi khyad par can gnyis/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi gang zhig rtog dpyod gnyis ka la chags pa dang ma bral ba de/dang po'i mtshan nyid/de gang zhig rtog pa la chags pa dang bral la dpyod pa tsam dang bcas pa de/gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/nang rab tu dang ba gnyen po'i yan lag gis/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rtog dpyod gnyis la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi sas bsdus kyi dga' bde gnyis kyi khyad par la bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ sems shin tu sbyangs pa las byung ba'i yid bde'i dbang po de/ dga' ba'i mtshan nyid/lus shin tu sbyangs pa las byung ba'i bde ba de/bde ba'i mtshan nyid tu 'dod do //rnal 'byor spyod pa ba ltar na/ yid shes 'khor gyi tshor ba sim par nyams su myong ba gcig nyid/ dbang po rten bcas kyi lus la phan 'dogs pa'i cha nas bde ba dang / yid shes 'bor bcas dga' rnam gyis tshim par byed pa'i cha nas dga' ba zhes 'jog go/ dran pa shes bzhin btang snyoms gnyen po'i yan lag gis/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sas bsdus kyi dga' ba nyon mongs can la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig dga' ba med pa'i bde ba phan

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 33yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/'dir bde ba ni sems kyi tshor ba sim par nyams su myong ba zhig yin la/ 'dir dga' ba nyon mongs can dang bral bas yid dga' bar mi byed kyi lus la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i mdor bde ba lus kyis myong la zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/dran pa yongs dag dang btang snyoms yongs dag gnyen po'i yan lag gnyis kyis bsam gtan gsum pa'i sas bsdus kyi bde ba la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi stoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/dmigs rnam kyi sgo nas/ 'og sa las nges par 'byung ba'am 'byung bzhin pa'i snyorma sa 'jug de/gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/de la dbye na/nyer bsdogs dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dmigs rnam kyi sgo nas gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed ba zhin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug de/ga/zugs med kyi nyer bsdogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs la sogs pa bzhi/chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bad byed bzhin pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dis nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyang bsgre bar byas shing /de la dbye rma//mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa sogs drug skabs 'dir nam mkha'i 'du shes la zhi ba dang / gzugs kyi 'du

134 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/shes la rags par lta ba yin no/ /yan lag mi 'dra ba dang bral ba'i dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral zin pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gzugs med nam mkha'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa dang bzhi'o/ /nam mkha'i 'du shes kyis gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig nam mkha'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba de/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/nam mkha'i yul can gyi rnam shes de nyid kyang mtha' yas so snyam pa'i 'ardu shes kyis nam mkha' la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig rnam shes kyi 'du shes dang ma bral ba de/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/gzung bya ci yang med do snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis rnam shes kyi 'du shes la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig ci yang med pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba de/ ci yang med pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/'du shes yod min med min gyi sgo nas 'du shes rags pa la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug de/ srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ mngon pa 'og ma ltar na/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yin na/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bas khyab la/ gong ma ltar na ma khyab pa yin no/ /yang snyoms 'jug la ngo bo'i sgo nas dngos btags ma phye bar dbye na/

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 135snyoms 'jug dag pa ba dang / snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can/ snyoms 'jug zag med dang gsum/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sas bsdus kyi 'jig rten pa'i dge ba rtse gcig pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyu'i snyoms 'jug dang / 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug gnyis/rang sa khams gong ma'i skye ba 'phen 'grub gang rung gi rgyur gyur pa'i 'jig rten pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ khams gong ma'i skye ba 'phen byed kyi snyoms 'jug dang / 'grub byed kyi snyoms 'jug gnyis/ dang po ni nyer bsdogs dag pa brgyad kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sems pa rnams yin la/gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dag pa brgyad kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sems sems byung rnams so/ /'dir rgyu'i snyoms 'jug la zag med dang nyon mongs can mi srid de/ rnam smin gyi rgyu yin na lung ma bstan dang zag med min dgos pa'i phyir/skye ba snga mar rgyu'i snyoms 'jug sgom pa'i rnam smin gyis thob pa'i rgyu mthun gyi snyoms 'jug de/ 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ 'dir rnam smin dngos ni/ khams gong ma'i 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug de la 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug ces bya zhing/ de la dag pa ba/ nyon mongs can/ zag med dang gsum yod do/ /snyoms 'jug dag pa ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyams pa cha mthun/gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin du/ dag pa ba'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig 'jug thog tu nyon

136 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/mongs skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ de gang zhig 'jug thog tu rang sa'i dag pa skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ de gang zhig 'jug thog tu gong sa'i snyoms 'jug skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ de gang zhig 'jug thog tu zag med kyi lam skye ba dang rjes n+da/ mthun pa/ snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig rags pa'i nyon mongs kyis rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa de/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sred pa shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can/ lta ba shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nga rgyal shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug the tshom shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can dang bzhi/ rang sa'i snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la ro myang ba'i sred pas ma zhi bar byas ba'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang sa'i lta ba ngan pas ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig rang sa'i nga rgyal gyis ma zhi bar byas pa de/gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig thar lam la yid gnyis za ba'i the tshom gyis ma zhi bar byas pa de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can de rnams sngar gyi snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun yin pa la der btags pa tsam yin gyi mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ snyoms 'jug gi yan lag rnams dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang /nyon mongs can la dga' bde dang / /rab dang shes bzhin dran pa dang / /btang snyoms dran pa dag pa med/ /

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 137ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer bsdogs yin na nyon mongs can mi dgos te/nyon mongs can gyis 'og ma la chags bral byed mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i sas bsdus kyi snyoms lajug gang zhig bden pa'i rnam pa can de/ snyoms 'jug zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ bsam gtan sa drug zag med dang po gsum ste zag med sa dgu'o/ /bsam gtan sa drug ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs/ dngos gzhi tsam po/ de'i dngos gzhi khyad pa ra can/ dngos gzhi phyi ma gsum dang drug go /nyer bsdogs phyi ma rnams la ni zag med mi srid de/ lam sla ba dngos gzhi la brten par dbang bzhin du lam dka' ba nyer bsdogs la mi brten pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam la/ thar par bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ lam tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ lha/ma lam/ mi tā(ba lam 51/ /theg pa rang lugs kyi sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ rang lugs kyi drod ma skyes gong gi bdag med la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i so skye'i mngon rtogs de/dang po 'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi/ rang rgyal gyi/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam dang gsum mo/ / theg pa rang lugs kyi tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa rdzogs rjes su byung zhing /bdag med la don spyi'i tshul gyi sgom byung gtso bor gyur ba'i mngon rtogs de/ sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med mngon du gsar du mthong ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/

138 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs de sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med mngon du rtogs pa mthar thug pa de/ mi slob pa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/ lam gsum po so so'i mtshan nyid kyang bdag med gsum po so so dang sbyar nas shes par bya'o/ /yang lam la dbye na/ sbyor ba'i lam/ bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang bzhi/rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon gyi cha shas re re nas sbong bar byed pa'i lam de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon ma lus par spong bar byed pa'i lam de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon drungs phyung ba'i gnas 'gyur gsar du sngon du bya ba'i lam de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam grol lam snga ma'i spang rtogs khyad par du byed pa'i lam de/ khyad par gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ spang bya gcig gi sa bon drungs 'byin par nus pa'i lam gcig la ltos te lam rim bzhin 'jog pa yin te/ dper na/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam de/ theg chen mthong lam la ltos pa'i sbyor ba'i lam dang / theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod de/ bar chad med pa'i lam dang / chos shes de rnam par grol ba'i lam dang / rjes bzod rjes shes lta bu khyad par gyi lam yin no/ /gsum pa tshad med la/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la brten nas phan par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ yang na

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 139khyad par bzhi ldan gyi tshangs pa'i gnas pa'o/ /de skad du yang / mdo sde rgyan las/bstan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'i〈cog / sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces so/ /de la dbye na/ byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/btang snyoms tshad med dang bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten te sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten te de bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten te de bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ de re re la sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang / chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang / dmigs med la dmigs pa'i byams pa la sogs pa re re la gsum gsum du dbye bas bcu gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dmigs yul sems can rdzas yod la dmigs nas bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can dang / gnyis pa ni/ phung po chos tsam kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can

140 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/dang // gsum pa ni/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can zhig yin la/ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /sa mtshams la tshad med tsam ni phyi rol pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ bye brag tu sems can la dmigs pa ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba/ chos la dmigs pa ni nyan rang dang thung mong ba/ dmigs med la dmigs pa ni/ byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /gsum pa tshogs sgrub la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhigarang 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chen gang rung dngos su 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod /'dir rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la// zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bshad pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bshad pa/ gzungs bshad pa/ sa bcu bshad pa/gnyen po'i tshogs bshad pa'o/ /dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhig lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde bas khyad par du byas pa de/ zhi gnas kyi mtshan nyid/rang rgyu zhi gnas las byung ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i she sa rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ lhag mthong gi mtshan nyid/ de 'a/ dbye na/ so sor rtogs pa'i lhag mthong dang / mi g.yo ba'i lhag mthong gnyis/stong nyid la sgo ma byung gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes de/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ stong nyid nyi shu rtogs pa'i yul can ye shes nyi shu'o/ /bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas rang gis khong du chud pa'i chos mi

skabs dang po rnam mkhyen/ 141brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tshig gi gzungs/ don gyi gzungs/ bzod pa'i gzungs/ sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i tshig mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas de'i don mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas stong pa nyid kyi don la mi skrag par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir ni bzod pa'i rgyu'i gzungs la bzod pa'i gzungs zhes bya'o/ /nad zhi ba la sogs pa'i don du sngags 'bras byin gyis rlob pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i dran pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir gzungs dngos ni dran pa yin la/ de'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i yi ge la yang de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa yin no/ /sa'i rnam par bzhag pa la yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ spyir sa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dang /byang sems kyi sa dang gsum/ nyan thos kyi yon tan du ma'i rten du gyur ba'i mkhyen pa de/ nyan thos kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong ba'i sa/ bsrabs pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa/rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang brgyad/rtogs pa'i stobs kyis dman pa'i byang chub tu rigs nges pa'i so skye'i mngon

142 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rtogs de/ rigs kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu ba'i nyan thos dang / rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam lta bu la bya/ zhugs gnas gang zhig brgyad kyi nang nas dang po'i mngon rtogs de/ brgyad pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rtogs pa lta bu'o/ /mthong spang tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ mthong ba'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu lta bu la bya'o/ /phal cher la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ bsrabs pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu lta bu'o/ /'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni phyir mi 'ong gi rtogs pa lta bu'o/ /khams gsum la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu lta bu la bya'o/ /theg pa gsum gyi nang nas chung ngu'i mngon rtogs de/ nyan thos kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni zhugs pa lhag ma gsum lta bu la bya/theg pa gsum gyi nang nas 'bring po'i mngon rtogs de/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rang rgyal gyi lam lnga la bya'o/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa gang zhig yon tan gyi rkyen byed pa de/ byang sems kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin bar bcu'o/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i sa de/ byang sems kyi sa dang po'i mtshan nyid/ ces pa nas/ ye shes kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/byang sems kyi sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid ces sbyar na gsung rab spyi dang mthun la/

skabs dang po rnam ma khyen/ 143yang na/ bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang / /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i yongs sbyong nyi shu'i sgo nas/ rjes thob tu sa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa'i sa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ smon lam dang ni mtha' yas dang / /zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i yongs sbyong bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas/ sa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed cing yon tan yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/byang sems kyi sa dgu pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi 'das sa sa dgu las 'das nas rjes thob tu smon lam gyi mthus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par nus pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/ sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa la/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon gyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang / sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub gnyis/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya mthong spang gi sa bon gyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni mthong lam bar chad med lam kho na la bya/ de la dbye na/ mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi'i dbye bas bzhi'o/ /sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /spyir gnyen po la rnam pa bzhi ste/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/ spong ba'i gnyen po/ rten gyi gnyen po/ thag bsrings pa'i gnyen po'o/ /rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya la thog mar nyes dmigs su lta ba'i lam de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni tshogs lam lta bu'o/ /rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon sbong bzhin pa'i lam de/gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sbyor ba'i lam dang / bar chad med pa'i lam

144 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam lta bu la bya zhing / gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam bar chad med pa'i lam lta bu'o/ /de yang sbyor ba'i lam gyis spang bya'i sa bon mgo mnon par byed cing bar chad med pa'i lam gyis drungs 'byin par byed pa yin no/ /spangs pa'i bral ba 'dzin par byed pa'i lam de/ rten gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rnam grol gyi lam lta bu'o/ /sngar spangs pa'i spang bya dang rang gis sems thag bsring bar byed/ pa'i lam de/ thag bsring ba'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni khyad par gyi lam lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa nges 'byung gi sgrub pa la ma/tshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gangatshozhig rang gi 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du gdon mi za bar dngos su 'byung ba'i bya ba de/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na nges par 'byung sa brgyad yod pa'i bye brag gis nges 'byung gi sgrub pa brgyad do/ /sa mtshams la nges 'byung gi sgrub pa tsam ni sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can ni rgyun mtha'i snga logs na yod/rnam kun mkhyen pa'i mdo gzhung yid 'phrog pa/ /rnam gsal mngon pa'i gzhung dang gzhan gzhung gis/ /rnam bshad phreng bar spel gang gis brgyan te / /rnam par dpyad nas 'brel chags ngag gis bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs dang po'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

skabs gnyis pa lam shes/ 145thub dbang bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan bzang gis/ /tshangs dang dbang po'i dregs pa nyams byas nas/ /sa chen 'di na lham mer mdzes gyur pa/ /bla med ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa rgyu mkhyen pa gnyi sa kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la/ rgyu'i gtso bo lam shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang / de la blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang / yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis/lam shes kyi khyad par bya byed gang gis bsdus pa'i chos de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/de la dbye na/ lam shes ma skyes pa skyes par byed pa'i yan lag dang / skyes nas phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yan lag gnyis sam/ lam gyi khyad par byed chos dang /rgyu lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos gnyis/ lam shes kyi rjes su 'gro ldog ma zhabrul ba'i rgyu de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rgyu lam shes gang la skyes ba'i rten dang / gang gis skyed pa'i rgyu gnyis/ gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur pa dang bral ba'i gang zag de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lam shes skye ba'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ba de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ yu/la nges pa dang / khyab pa gnyis/ lhan cig byed rkyen byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/nyer len gyi rgyu rigs kyis khyab pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/gnyis pa lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos la mtshan nyid ni/ lam shes dang ngo bo gcig pa'i sgo nas de la rjes su 'gro ldog mi zhabrul ba'o/ /de la dbye na/ rang

146 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/bzhin dang / byed las gnyis/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi sbong ba'i rang bzhin de/ rgyu lam shes kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyu la gnas nas gzhan don byed pa'i las de/ rgyu lam shes kyi byed las kyi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa yan lag can gyi lam shes la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/thabs khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de/ skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyu lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'og ma rnams la yang 'di'i rigs pas shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/dang po la mtshan nyid dang / shes bya lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/dang po mtshan nyid ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang rig gis shes par bya ba'i lam dang / gzhan rig gis shes par bya ba'i lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems rang rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la bya/ gnyis pa ni nyan thos rang rgyud kyi lam rnams la bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la/ gtso bor rang 'bras nyan thos kyi

skabs gnyis pa lam shes/ 147rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam gyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dngos dang / shes bya lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/rang rgyal gyi lam bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid kyi zur du byang sems kyi mngon rtogs sbyar ba de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i don du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ snga ma ltar gnyis so/ /shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam la/ lam rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par dang /nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i khyad par/ rten rigs kyi khyad par ro/ /rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya shes sgrib gzung rtog gi sa bon la dngos su gnod byed dam/ de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam gang rung gi rtogs rigs su gnas pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya shes sgrib 'dzin rtog gi sa bon la gnod byed ma yin pa'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad

148 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/par de gnyis dang ldan pa'i shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la/ lam bgrod tshul dang / chos ston tshul gyi khyad par gnyis/ slob dpon gzhan la rag ma las par rang rgyalatshogyi sbyor lam nas rang byang chub kyi bar tshe gcig la mngon du byed nus pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus sgra med par rang gi gdul bya la rtogs pa bskyed nus pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid /gtso bor rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ der gyur pa'i drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid dngos dang / shes bya lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa gnyis/ byang sems kyi lam bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ zur du byang sems kyi mkhyen pa sbyar nas/ skabs gnyis par dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi 'a ma shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ byang sems rang rgyud la bskyed nas mngon su/ma du bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam dang / sgom lam gnyis/

skabs gnyis pa larma shes/ 149gnyis pa ni/ gtso bor theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ byang sem sa kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshamyo/ nyid yin la/ de ni skabs dang por bstan zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis par ma bstan no/ /mdo las phan yon chen po dang ldan par dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug bcu drug ni sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes te bzhi/ de bzhin du bden pa gzhan gsum la'ang bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /so so'i ngos 'dzin la spyir bshad pa dang / 'dir bstan bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid sngar ma rtogs gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya sdug bsngal mthong spang gi sa bon drungs 'byin par nus pa'i bar chad med lam de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya sdug bsngal mthong spang las dngos su grol ba'i rnam grol gyi lam de/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes kyi mtshan nyid/ ye shes snga ma gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur mngon sum du rtogs pa'i khyad par gyi lam gang zhig bzod pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid/theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes shes de la nges pa 'dren nus kyi theg chen gyi mthong lam gang zhig shes pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lhag ma gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du sbyar

150 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/bar bya'o/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa bcu drug ni rim pa bzhin du/ de bzhin nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dbyer med du rtogs pas mtshon nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang / mdor na sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs chen po yin par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang / sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs 'jal byed kyi tshad ma med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang / sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs nam mkha' ltar tshad med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyang gzhung nyid la rnam par brtags nas sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa theg chen sgom lam la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ dbye na bcu gnyis/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam dang /zag med sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gang zhig rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ dbye na/ mos pa yid la

skabs gnyis pa lam shes/ 151byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam sogs gsum/dang po la mtshan nyid dngos dang / mos pa'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/lung rigs rnam dag la brten nas yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ rang don mos pa yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam/ gnyis don/ gzhan don mos pa yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ lung rigs rnam dag la brten nas yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su dang / gnyis don gyi 'byung gnas su dang / gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ sa mtshams rim pa bzhin du sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar dang /brgyad pa dang / dgu pa gnyis dang / bcu pa rnams la bzhag go /gnyis pa mos pa'i rnam gzhag la/ dngos dang / phan yon gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ lung rigs rnam dag la brten nas sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ rang don mos pa/ gnyis don mos pa/ gzhan don mos pa dang gsum/ de re re la yang chung 'bring dgu dgur phye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /sa mtshams la mos pa tsam ni tshogs sbyor nas kyang yod la/ khyad par can gyi sa mtshams ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa phan yon la mtshan nyid ni/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i mos pa gsum gang rung sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar kyi yon tan/ dbye na/ bstod pa/ bkur ba/ bsngags pa dang gsum/

152 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyi yon tan brjod pa chung ngu mdzad pa de/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ yum gnyis don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyi yon tan brjod pa 'bring du mdzad pa'i ngo bor gnas pa de/'dir bstan bkur ba'i mtshan nyid/ yum gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyi yon tan brjod pa chen por mdzad pa'i ngo bor skyes pa de/ 'dir bstan gyi bsngags pa'i mtshan nyid/ de re re la yang chung 'bring dgu dgur dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /gnyis pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang / bsngo ba'i rnam gzhag gnyis/mtshan nyid ni/ rang ga‘nan gyi dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa khyad par can dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na bcu gnyis so/ /sa mtshams ni sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/gnyis pa 'a / rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan par 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'dir bstan bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ spyir bsngo ba tsam la mngon mtho'i rgyur bsngo ba dang / nges legs kyi rgyur bsngo ba gnyis yod la/ phyi ma la yang theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas rnam pa gsum mo/ /'dir bstan gyi bsngo ba la khyad par can gyi bsngo ba'i ming can sogs bcu gnyis yod la/ de yang dang po dgu ni ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba

skabs gnyis pa lam shes/ 153yin zhing phyi ma gsum ni chung 'bring gi sgo nas phye ba yin no/ /sa mtshams la bsngo ba tsam ni tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ 'dir bstan gyi bsngo ba khyad par can ni sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/gsum pa rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang / yi rang gi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la mngon par dga' ba'i dad pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ 'di la dbye ba ma bshad la/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas sa bcu pa 'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor ba rnam mkhyen yid byed dang dngos gzhi mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la mngon par dga' ba'i dad pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'dir bstan gyi rjes su yi rang gi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor nas yod la/spyir yi rang tsam ni theg pa gsum la yang yod do/ /gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang zhigamanyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid/dbye na/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dngos dang / mdo las gsungs pa'i rnam dag gi dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /

154 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/dang po ni/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig mnyam bzhag rnam grol lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'o/ /sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi bral rgyu bar chad med lam gyis ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon spangs pas thob pa'i bral ba de/ rnam dag tsam gyi mtshan nyid/de la nyan thos kyi rnam dag rang rgyal gyi/ byang sems kyi rnam dag rnam dag shin tu ba dang bzhi/rang gi ngo skal gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam spangs pa'i bral ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rgyun zhugs kyi/ phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong gi dgra bcom gyi rnam dag dang bzhi/ de re re la yang rnam grol lam dang / so sor brtags 'gog gnyis gnyis yod do/ /ngo skal gyi nyon sgrib dang ngo skal gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam spangs pas bral ba de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bod snga ma rnams kyis rgyun zhugs kyi rnam dag dang / dgra bcom gyi rnam dag gnyis su 'chad kyang rigs pas mi 'thad do/ /lam gsum phyin ci ma log par shes pa la gegs byed du gyur pa'i ngo skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i byang sems kyi bral ba de/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs pa'i bral ba de/rnam dag shin tu ba'i mtshan nyid/lam bral gzhan dang rang nyid kyang / /lam bzang nyid la 'jug bya'i phyir/ /
skabs gnyis pa lam shes/ 155lam gsum yan lag dang bcas pa/ /lam shes nyi da kyi mdo bzhin bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs gnyis pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

156 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i skyon dgongs shing / /snying rje chen pos zhi ba'i mtha' spangs nas/ /byang chub chen lngardzo'i gnas sdo/ zhugs sdo/ra pa/ /phrin las chen po de la phyag bgyi'o/ /gnyis pa blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes la/ 'jug yul gzhi shes/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang /dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lam sher phyin dang de'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gang rung de/dang po'i mtshan nyid/dbye na lam sher phyin dang / de'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gnyis/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje chen po zung du 'brel ba'i mkhyen pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ shes rab kyis 'khor ba la mi gnar+sā pa'i sher phyin/ snying rjes zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i sher phyin/ de gnyis kyi byed pa sdom pas 'bras yum la nye ba'i sher phyin/ nye ba'i rgyu mtshan gnyen po'i sher phyin dang bzhi/shes rab kyis 'khor ba rang bzhin me da par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi thabs mkhas kyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin gyi sa bon dngos su 'joms nus pa'i byang sems kyi

skabs gsum pa gzhi shes/ 157gzhi shes de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang bral ba'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs de/ gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes/ ring ba'i rgyu mtshan mi mthun phyogs dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes so/ /'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/zhar la mtshan 'dzin gsum gyi mtshan nyid la/ gzhi phung /bams skye mched la bdag med sogs su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'jin de/ gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyin paṃ nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar lam gyi dngos po la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin de/ 'dir bstan lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'a thob bya mthar thug tu 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin de/ 'dir bstan 'bras bu la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin tsam ni 'dir bstan mtshan 'dzin du mi bzung ste/ 'dir bstan mtshan 'dzin de mtshan 'dzin tsam gyi gnyen por gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor bsdu na/ bshad ma thag pa'i mi mthun phyogs dang /gnyen po'i rab dbye bde blag tu rtogs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rma/ngon rtogs de/ yul can gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /de ni ji skad du / de ltar kun shes nyid

158 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/lugs la/ /zhes pa'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa sbyor ba la/ dngos dang / mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po la/dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba dang / shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba rnams so /dang po la/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/yul bcu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bcur phye la/ de yang bya dka' rnam gsum la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba gcig tu byas pa yin no/ /bcu po bsdu na nyi snang las/dang po bzhi la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang / phyi ma drug la sbyor ba tsam gyi tha snyad mdzad/ slob dpon gyis ni thams cad la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba tsam gyi tha snyad byas so/ /sa mtshams ni sbyor lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /sbyor ba bcu so so'i rnam gzhag la/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi rang gi ngo bo la sgrub pa yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/ gzugs sogs la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de nas de'i bar la rtag mi rtag tu sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/ de mi rtag la sogs spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de nas de'i bar gyi rdzogs ma rdzogs la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/ gzugs sogs rdzogs ma rdzogs la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ ces sogs mdo dang 'grel ba la sogs la rnam par brtags nas sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhar la 'dir bstan gyi rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / spyir mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kun btags pa'i

skabs gsum pa gzhi shes/ 159gzugs dang tshor ba dang rnam mkhyen gyi bar la ni ma rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ blos gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa sgro btags pa tsam yin gyi btags pa de nyid don la med pas yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pas sgro btags pas stong ba'i gzugs la sogs pa de bzhin nyid de la ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa zhes bya la/ de dag ni chos can/ rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pas stobs sogs yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ bag chags yongs su smin pa'i mthu las gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs par snang tsam de la/ rnam par btags pa'i gzugs zhes bya la/de ni kun btags kyi gdags gzhi dang / yongs grub kyi chos can yin pas/rdzogs ma rdzogs dpyod pa'i dpyad gzhi yin pa'i phyir dngos su ma bstan la/ 'on kyang gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo la spyod pa bkag pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhi bstan pa de yin no/ /gnyis pa spyir mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ rnam rig pa'i lugs dang / dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/dang po la/ don la med bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i cha de/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rnam grangs pa'i kun btags dang / mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun btags gnyis te/ dang po ni/ chos chos can/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed/ spyi dang bye brag rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag lta bu'o/ /rgyu rkyen gzhan gyi dbang las skyes pa de gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/dag pa gzhan dbang dang / ma dag pa gzhan dbang gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam byang gi phyogs dang mthun pa'i shes pa rnams la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi

160 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/phyogs dang mthun pa'i shes pa rnams la bya/ rnam dag gi dmigs pa de/ yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la bya/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba de dag ni dngos btags so sor ma phye ba'i dbang du byas na mngon pa gong ma las gsungs la/ dngos btags so sor phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ sgro 'dogs byed/ kyi rtog pa'i ngor yod pas tha snyad du yod cing / btags pa ltar rdzas su med pas don la med pa'i chos de/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bdag gnyis kyi don spyi dang / gzugs sgra la sogs pa phyi rol gyi skye mched rnams so/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa de/ gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong ba'i de kho na nyid de yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ de skad du yang / theg bsdus las/rnga/ma par rtog pas btags pa'i don/ /kun tu btags pa 'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyi dbang / /de'i chos nyid yongs su grub/ / ces so /gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ spyir dbu ma'i gzhung las mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par ma gsungs kyang / 'grel chen dang / dbu ma snang ba las phyogs tsam gsungs pa'i don blangs na/ chos rnams kyi steng du rtog pas sgro

skabs gsum pa gzhi shes/ 161btags pa'i cha de/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ sgro 'dogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i rten brten 'byung sgyu ma lta bu de gzhan dbang / chos can sgyu ma lta bu'i steng du ji ltar sgro btags pas stong pa'i stong nyid de/ yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /mdor na nyan rang gi sbyor ba 'di sngar bshad pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin la 'jug par byed cing 'bras bu rnam mkhyen dang ring bar byed do/ /byang sems kyi spyor bas ni bshad ma thag pa'i lam sher phyin la 'jug par byed cing 'bras bu rnam mkhyen dang nye bar byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid la/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la rlom pa rnam pa bzhi bkag nas sgom pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor/ de'i mtshan nyid do/ /rlom pa rnam pa bzhi ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i ngo bo la mngon par zhen pa dang /khyad par sngon po la sogs pa'i mtshan mar zhen pa dang / gzugs rnam pa nyi shu la sogs pa'i dbye ba la mngon par zhen pa dang / nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rlom pa bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /ji skad du/ mdo las gzugs rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gis zhes rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed ces pa'i don no/ /gsum pa zhugs 'bras mthong lam la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi dang /shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam mo/ /mdo las/ sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba'i rnam pa can du bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/skabs gsum par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye

162 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag spros pa dang bral bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan pa'i sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid dang / tshor ba bde sdug gi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dang / don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid spros pa dang bral bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dang / ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag yod med kyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid ces sogs gzhung nyid la brtags nas sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can du sgro 'dogs pa'i theg dman gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ shugs bstan nyan rang gi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zhar la skabs gsum par mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun/ ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ de 'dra'i sgom lam de ni mi dmigs pas skabs gsum pa 'dir ma bstan pa yin no/ /gzhi yi gnas lugs ji ltar shes pa yis //gzhi lam rnam gsum mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo/ /gzhi nas spangs te lam la 'arnacog pa'i tshul/ /gzhi shes ston pa'i mdo bzhin legs par bshad/ / ces bya ba ni skabs gsum pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 163skye med gsum la thos dang bsam pa yis/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros brgya phrag gis/ /yun du goms pas nyes kun rgyang bsrings te/ /mthon po'i go 'phang brnyes der phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs sbyor ba bzhi bshad pa la/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang / brtan pa rgyu 'bras kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang / 'bras bu rtse sbyor gyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/spyir theg chen gyi sbyor ba la/ 'jug tshul gtan la dbab pa dang / bye brag tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i sgom lam gyi rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshon bya theg chen gyi sbyor ba bshad pa dang / de'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshon pa'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsgom bya'i rnam pa bshad pa dang / sgom pa po'i gang zag gi rnam pa de sgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spyir bshad pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i rnam pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ yul gyi khyad par de rnam pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/don rnam dang / shes rnam ga nyis/ shes pas khyad par du ma byas pa'i don gyi rnam pa de/ don rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi lta ba gang zag gi bdag med kyi don rnam dang / rang bzhin skye med lta bu chos kyi bdag med kyi don rnam gnyis/ yul la dmigs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par de/ shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na mi mthun phyogs kyi shes rnam dang / gnyen po'i shes rnam
