164 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/gnyis/ yul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa lta bu'o/ /yul gyi gnas tshul dang mthun par zhugs pa'i blo'i 'dzin stangs de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sgrib par rtog pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bden bzhi gang rung rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi theg chen sbyor ba'i bsgom bya shes rnam kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la yang dngos btags kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mtshan nyid pa byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa dang / rjes mthun pa nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud la yod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa'i skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la bya/ gnyis pa ni/nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud la yod pa'i skye med gsum rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la bya'o/ /mtshan btags kyi khyad par de bzhin du 'thad pa yin no/ /sgom pa po'i blo de nyid sgom byed kyi rnam pa de'i ngo bor bskyed pa la rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du 'jog pa'i phyir/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzhi shes kyi shes rnam/ lam shes kyi shes rnam/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang gsum/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i gzhi shes kyi shes rnam dang / bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i gzhi shes kyi shes rnam gnyis/ chos can gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga ste nyer bdun no/ /nyer bdun bsdus na gnyis su 'dus so/ /mngon pa dang thun mong ba'i shes rnam dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rnam gnyis/ sher phyin dang mngon pa gnyis ka las gang zag gi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can du bstan pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / nyon

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 165sgrib kyi gnyen por bstan pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi rnams so/ /chos mngon pa las ma bshad cing / sher phyin las gzung ba chos kyi bdag med nyid rtogs pa'i cha nas bstan pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa bcu gcig po rnams la bya/ yang na bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa dang lam bden gyi rnam pa'o/ /bden pa dang po gsum gang zag gi bdag med du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan bsgom bya dang po gsum gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sdug bden mi rtag par rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi shes rnam sogs bcu gnyis/ gzhi shes kyi lam bden las phye ba'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya lam bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med kyi rnam pa bzhi dang / shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag bcas kyi rnam pa lnga/ de'i gnyen por lam zag med nyid kyi rnam pa drug ste bco lnga'o/ /nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan lam dang po'i mtshan nyid yin la/ mkhyen pa gsum po de'i cha shas su gyur pa'i lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/nges 'byin bzhi'am/ byed pa po'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs sogs de la lam dang po'i shes rnam zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i rjes thob ye shes de la lam gnyis pa zhes bya/de'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes de la lam gsum pa zhes bya/ lam de gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par bcu gcig po de la de'i rnam pa zhes bya'o/ /'dir lam dang po ni nyan rang dang byang sems thams cad la yod

166 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/la/ lam phyi ma gnyis ni rang rgyal dang byang sems kho na la yod la/ de dag gi rnam pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /mdor bsdu na 'dir gzhi shes kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mthong lam dang sgom lam la 'dir lam bden zhes bya/ mthong lam dang sgom lam de gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag la lam bden gyi shes rnam zhes bya/ de yang bsgom bya mtshan nyid pa ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa de nyid yin la/nyan rang rgyud la yod pa ni rtogs rigs kyi rten so sor nges pa'i rnam gsal gyi dper brjod yin gyi bsgom bya dngos min no/ /lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ kun 'byung bden pa'i shes rnam/ lam bden gyi/ sdug bden gyi/ 'gog bden gyi shes rnam dang bzhi/lam shes kyi shes rnam gang zhig kun 'byung bden pa spangs gnyen gyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan kun 'byung bden pa'i shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na brgyad/lam shes kyi shes rnam gang zhig lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan lam bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bdun/de gang zhig sdug bden rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi sdug bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga/de gang zhig 'gog bden blo bur dri bral gyi ngo bor rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi 'gog bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 167bcu drug po de yang bsdu na/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa/ zhi ba'i/ gya nom pa'i/ nges 'byung gi rnam nga/ dang bzhi/blo bur rnam dag gi stong nyid dang po gsum rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong pa nyid la sogs pa brgyad rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong pa nyid la sogs pa bzhi rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/mdor bsdu na gzhi shes kyi shes rnam ni/ gzhi shes kyi 'dzin stangs dngos sam de dang rjes su mthun pa gcig yin la/ rjes su mthun pa ni tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs na yang yod cing / de sgom pa la gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom par gzhag go /gzhi shes kyi 'dzin stangs dngos ni 'phags pa thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du 'du/nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa ni spyir gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa yin yang /'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya shes rnam mtshan nyid pa min/ 'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya shes rnam ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na'o/ /lam shes kyi shes rnam la yang de'i rigs pas sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam la rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ yang na/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ gzhi shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi

168 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/mtshan nyid/ theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan du bsdus pa mthar thug pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gnyis/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rtogs pa'i rigs rgyun mtshan nyid pa 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/dbye na/ nyan rang dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang / byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gnyis/dang po la/ dngos dang / byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ / rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun lta bu'o/ /'dir rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dngos ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi de nyid yin la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom bya shes rnam ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i byang phyogs so bdun po de nyid yin zhing / nyan rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i so bdun ni sangs rgyas kyi so bdun po de dang rjes su mthun par ston pa'i rnam gsal gyi dpe tsam yin gyi/ shes rnam dngos dang / bsgom bya shes rnam gnyis ka min zhing / rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam rjes mthun pa yang min te/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi gtso bo dang rjes su mthun pa med pa'i phyir/gnyis pa byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes kyi phyogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos byang chub phyogs mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga las/

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 169dang po dran pa nyer bzhag la/ mtshan nyid ni/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi po gang rung la rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rtog par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na lus dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa bzhi/ phyi nang gi lus rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang / tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang / tshor ba ma gtogs pa'i sems byung thams cad dang / ldan min 'du byed dang / 'dus ma byas kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/gnyis pa yang dag spong ba la/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang gnyen blang dor byed pa'i brtson 'grus de/ yang dag sbong ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mi dge ba skyes pa sbong ba'i dang / ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa'i dang / dge ba skyes pa spel bar byed pa'i dang /ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhi/ de dag gi mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin du/ kun nas nyon mongs pa skyes pa spong ba'i phyir du 'dun pa bskyed/'bad/ brtson 'grus rtsom/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ sems rab tu 'jog par byed pa'i brtson 'grus gnas dang bcas pa'o zhes sbyar ro/ /de la 'dun pa ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so/ /'bad pa ni zhi gnas dang rab tu 'dzin pa dang / btang snyoms kyi mtshan ma yid la byed pa de brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i dus dngos so/ /brtson 'grus rtsom pa ni/ bying rgod sel ba'i don du brtson 'grus rtsom pa de/ des spyir bstan nas ji ltar du rtsom zhe na/ bying ba ni sku gzugs sogs la sems rab

170 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/tu 'dzin pa dang / rgod pa ni sems nang du rab tu 'jog pa'o/ /sa mtshams ni/nyan thos kyi tshogs lam 'bring nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'o/ /gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i sems gnas pa las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi las/ gus pas sbyor ba'i 'dun pa la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ rgyun du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa mtshung sa ldan dang bcas pa de/brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ sngon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bag chags dang ldan pa'i sems la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshe 'dir chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la brten nas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ni/ 'dun pa/ rtsol ba/ dad pa/ shin sbyangs/ dran pa/ shes bzhin/sems pa/ btang snyoms so/ /nyes pa lnga spong ba'i phyir mngon par 'du byed pas na spong ba'i 'du byed ces bya/ de las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya zhing / 'dir rdzu 'phrul ni spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams la bya la/ de'i rten yin pa'i phyir rkang pa zhes bya'o/ /nyes pa lnga ni ji skad du/le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 171'du mi byed dang 'du byed dang / /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes pa ltar bying rgod gnyis po gcig tu byas pa'o/ /le lo'i gnyen po ni bzhi ste/'dun pa ni rten yin te/ rtsol ba ni de la brten pa yin/ dad pa ni 'dun pa'i rgyu yin/ shin tu sbyangs pa ni rtsol ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyen po phyi ma bzhi dang / nyes pa phyi ma bzhi spang gnyen du sbyar ro/ /sa mtshams ni nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa dbang po la/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la bdag por gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga las/ dbang po gang zhig bden pa rnams la yid ches pa'i sems byung de/ dad pa'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/de gang zhig bden pa bzhi bsgom pa la spro ba'i sems byung de/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa'i dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i sems byung de/ dran pa'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa bzhi'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems byung de/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa bzhi rab tu 'byed pa'i sems byung mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/shes rab kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshungs ldan zhes pa kun la sbyar ro/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi drod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /lnga pa stobs la/ ma dad pa la sogs pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dad pa'i stobs la sogs pa lnga/ dad pa'i dbang po gang zhig ma dad pas brdzi bar mi nus pa de/

172 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/dad pa'i stobs gyi mtshan nyid ces sogs sbyar bar bya'o/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi bzod pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /drug pa byang chub yan lag la/ bden pa mngon nga ra rtogs pa'i lam de/ byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/dran 'byed brtson dga' sbyangs ting 'dzin/ /btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun/ /zhes pa'o/ /mtshan nyid ni/ byang chub kyi gnas kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i dran pa de/dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ byang chub kyi ngo bo'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo dang / byang chub kyi nges 'byung gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i brtson 'grus dang / byang chub kyi phan yon gyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i dga' ba dang / gang gis kyang nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i shin sbyangs dang / gang du yang nyon mongs par ma gyur pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i ngo bo'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i btang snyoms rnams so/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na'o/ /bdun pa 'phags lam yan lag la/ sgom spang dag par byed pa'i mngon rtogs de/ 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/lta rtog ngag dang las kyi mtha'/ /'tsho rtsol dran ting yan lag brgyad/ /

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 173ces pa'o/ /mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ 'phags lam yan lag gang zhig ces sbyar nas/ mnyam bzhag tu rtogs pa'i de kho na nyid nges par 'dzin pa'i blo dang / ji ltar rtogs pa'i don gzhan la ston pa'i ngag kun nas slong byed dang / rang smra ba po lta ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang / rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de tshul khrims rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang / rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de 'tsho ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang / sgom spang du gyur pa'i nyon sgrib kyi bag chags spong bar byed pa'i yan lag dang / bying rgod la sogs pa nye nyon gyi bag chags sbyong bar byed pa'i yan lag dang / spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan la sgrib pa sbyong bar byed pa'i yan lag go /sa mtshams ni nyan thos kyi sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod do/ /gnyis pa la/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnyen po'i lam la sogs pa drug skabs 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dngos ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa so bzhi po de nyid yin la/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa so ba zhi ni bsgom bya shes rnam dngos dang / rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam rjes mthun pa tsam yin la/ nyan rang gi rgyud 'a yod pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam thar brgyad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms 'jug dgu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ nyon sgrib tsam gyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag gi gnyen po'i rigs su mi gnas pas/'dir lam shes kyi rnam par ma bzhag pa yin no/ /

174 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/des na 'dir bsgom bya shes rnam de nyid ngos 'dzin pa la/ gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de/gnyen po'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ mtshan ma med pa'i tingatshonge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ bdag tu lta ba dang bdag gir lta ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni stong pa bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu la zer/ 'jig lta'i rgyu dang 'bras bur gyur pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de/ 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'gog lam gyi rnam pa bzhi rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu la bya/ khams gsum la sred pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang / kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu la bya'o/ /gnyis pa sprul ba'i lam la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzhan du sprul ba sna tshogs 'byor bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar dang gsum/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi sems rten bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rnal 'byor pa rang la gzugs can du 'du shes pa'i

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs spyor ba/ 175sgo nas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la sna tshogs su lta ba yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de la brten nas rang la gzugs can gyi 'du shes rnam par bshig pa'i sgo nas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la der blta ba'i zhes sogs/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de la brten nas 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas sdug par ro gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gsum pa mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la/ rang sgom pa po'i rgyud la lus sem sa shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bskrun par byed pa'i snyoms 'jug de/de'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbye na/ thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam dang / zhi bar gnas pa'i lam gnyis/ thar pa myang ngan las 'das pa dang khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa mngon gyur pa dang bral tsam du mtshungs pa'i lam de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzugs med kyi rnam par thar pa bzhi/ tshor 'du rags pa zhi ba'i lam gyi rang bzhin de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig pu la bya'o/ /'dir rnam thar dang snyoms 'jug gi khyad par la mngon pa 'og ma ba ltar na/sa 'og ma la rgyab kyis phyogs pa de rnam thar gyi don dang / der mi phyogs pa de snyoms 'jug tsam gyi don du bzhed pas nyer bsdogs kyi bar chad med lam rnams snyoms 'jug kho na yin gyi rnam thar min la/ nyer bsdogs kyi rnam grol lam dgu pa nas dngos gzhi'i rnam thar du 'jog go /de yang bsam gtan dang po gnyis na rnam thar dang po gnyis/ rnam thar gsum pa ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ngo bor skye bar 'dod do/ /mngon pa gong ma ba ltar na rang sa'i ro myang gi sred pa dang bral

176 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ba'i cha nas rnam thar dang / de dang 'dres pa'i cha nas snyoms 'jug tu 'jog go /de yang rnam thar dang po gsum ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skyes pas khyab/ gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug la yang rang gi dngos gzhis khyab pa yin te/ gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs rnams ni rang sa la sred pa'i sgo nas der 'phen byed yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la ni rnam thar gyis khyab pa yin no/ /bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ 'phags rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang dgu/ 'dir byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas pas 'das lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug kyang yod do/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang mngon pa dang mthun par byed na/ snyoms par 'jug pa na 'das lam kho nas 'jug pas 'das lam du bzhag bosto /'dir 'gog snyoms kyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ nyan thos kyi lugs dang /theg chen gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag gzhi lus kyi steng du dgag bya rnam shes tshogs drug gam/ tshogs bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bkag pa'i snyoms 'jug rdzas yod kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed/gnyis pa la/ theg chen thun mong ba'i lugs dang / thun mong min pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag gzhi kun gzhi'i steng du zhi gnas khyad par can srid rtse'i sems dang lhag mthong khyad par can 'das lam gnyis/ dgag bya rnam shes tshogs bdun 'khenar dang bcas pa bkag pa'i gnas skabs la btags pa'i

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 177ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed/ 'di la snyoms par 'jug pa po ni phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed dang / dgra bcom gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyis snyoms par 'jugabyang sems ni theg chen gyi mthong lam nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i nus pa 'thob la/ de yang gzhan don du shes par bya ba'i phyir du snyoms par 'jug pa yin gyi rang don du mngon du bya ba'i phyir du ni min no/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni 'gogatshosnyoms 'di la snyoms par 'jug pa med de de'i dgag gzhi med pa'i phyir/ 'dir snyoms 'jug tu bshad kyang ting nge 'dzin dngos min te/ ldan min 'du byed du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi mnyam par bsgrub pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sems kyis thob pa'i phyir snyoms 'jug ces bya'o/ /'di'i gnas skabs na yid kyi shes pa mi gsal ba'i ngo bor yod par 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ de btsun pa dbyig shes kyi 'dod par byas nas theg bsdus su bkag pa'i phyir/ 'di mi rtog ye shes kyi ngo bor 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ theg bsdus dang rgyal sras ma las/ rtog dpyod nye bar zhi bas mi rtog ye shes su 'jog na/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang der 'gyur ro zhes de yin pa bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /'di srid rtse'i sems kho nas 'thob dgos par bshad pa yang der brtson pa'i tshe yin gyi phyis ni der ma nges te/ yum gyi mdo las sa dgu'i sems la brten pa zhig yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ dgag bya tshogs bdun 'gog par bshad pa yang 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de kho na ltar ma nges te/ khams gong ma gnyis su sna lte'i rnam par shes pa gnyis dgag mi dgos pa'i phyir/ ci yang med la chags bral byas par bshad pa yang spyir btang ba yin gyi/ dmigs bsal la de mi dgos par rgyal sras ma las bshad cing 'dod gzugs kho na'i rten du

178 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/bshad pa yang kun gyi rnam par ma bzhag pa'i dbang du byas par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las ngachond do/ /theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la/ dgag gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi steng du dgag bya spros pa'i tshogs mtha' dag bkag pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ 'di sa dang po nas thob la/drug pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon la gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ spong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzod pa bzhi'o/ /sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i go skabs phyi shul du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyin sogs pha rol du phyin pa bcu'o/ /bshad ma thag pa'i sprul ba'i lam sogs de dag la 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mtshan nyid shes par 'dod na/ mtshan nyid kyi zur du byang sems kyi mkhyen pa sbyor/ skabs 'dir ni dngos gzhan dang bsgom bya shes rnam gnyis ka byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin la/snga ma byang phyogs so bdun 'chad pa'i skabs su/ dngos gzhan nyan rang dang /bsgom bya shes rnam byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin la/ de gnyis ka'i skabs su sangs rgyas kyi so bdun dang po bzhis mtshon nas bstan pa la khyad par med do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa de/ thun mong min pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ brten pa yon tan gyi dbye ba dang / rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin gnyis/dang po la sde tshan bzhi las/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas shes bya ma lus pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes de/ stobs kyi mtshan

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 179nyid/ de la dbye na bcu/ 'dir stobs bcu po thun mong min pa'i rnam par bshad kyang / de gang rung yin na de yin pas ma khyab ste/ sangs rgyas kyi dran pa nyer bzhag kyang de'i stobs yin pa'i phyir/bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas 'khor gyi dbus su dam bca' 'jog pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing / chos mi mthun gyis rgol bar mi nus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa de/ mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzhi/bsam gtan/ gyi rab mtha' la brten nas bshad bya dang 'chad byed thogs med du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ so sor yang dag par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi/mdo las ma 'dres pa'i ming gis dngos su bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ ma 'dres pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa drugartogs pa ma 'dres pa drug 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin bshad pa la gsum las/ chos nyid ji lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji snyed pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ rang byung gi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bsgom bya dngos ni byang sems kyi thugs rgyud la yod pa'i stobs la sogs pa rjes mthun pa rnams 'a/ 'dod dgos so/ /gnyis pa sgom pa po'i gang zag gis bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa la/

180 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/sgom pa po'i gang zag bshad pa dang / bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yum nyan pa'i snod du rung ba'i sems dpa' de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/dbye na yum nyan pa'i snod/ 'dzin pa'i snod/ don la mi brjed par sems pa'i snod/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i snod dang bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi cesags lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na skusnad/gnyis pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba dngos dang / sngon 'gro'i chos gnyis/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ste nyi shu'o/ /sa mtshams ni tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i chos la/ blang bar bya ba yon tan dang / dor bar bya ba skyon gnyis/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi skusnan tan de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi/ sa mtshams dzadzhags lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i chos de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na zhe drug sa mtshams sa bdun pa man chad na sku1da/gnyis pa theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la/ theg chen sbyor ba mtshon byed dang theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi gang rung du dmigs pa de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid dang / las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid gnyis/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs spyor ba/ 181gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ de la ming gi sgo nas dbye na/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan dang gsum/theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las shes pa zhe brgyad kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la ming gi sgo nas dbye na/gzhi shes sbyor ba'i/ lam shes sbyor ba'i/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang gsum/ gzhi shes sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs shes pa bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bcu drug lhag ma gnyis kyang des bsgre bar bya'o/ /theg chen gyi sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las khyad chos bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drugayang de gang zhig mdo las byed pa bcu gcig gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/dbye na bcu gcig go /bcu gcig po yang gsum du 'du ste/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa bdun/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed pa gcig go /theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan nyid kyis mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid de/

182 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid ces kyang bya la/ theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid ces kyang bya'o/ /de la dbye na/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bzhi/ lam shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid lnga/rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bdun no/ /mdor na de dag mtshan gzhir bzhag nas rim pa bzhin du zab pa dang /gting dpag dka' ba dang / tshad med pa'i sbyor ba gsum du mtshon pa la gzhi lam rnam gsum la dmigs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang / byed pa gsum dang /bdun dang / gcig dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid du sbyor zhing /de dag mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la/ theg chen sbyor ba thun mong min par mtshon byed ces sogs mtshon sbyor gyi rnam gzhag rigs pas brtags nas shes par bya'o/ /bye brag tu khyad mtshan gyi mtshon tshul ni/ gting dpag dka' ba dang tshad med pa gnyis mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen sbyor bar mtshon pa la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid du gzung bar bya'o/ /'dir mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / zab pa'i sbyor ba sogs ni mtshon bya rnam grangs pa yin la/ de yang gzugs sogs gang zag gi bdag med pas zab pa dang / chos kyi bdag med pas gting dpag dka' ba dang / bdag gnyis kas stong pas tshad med pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i go rim bshad pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam sku gsum so sor ma phye ba'i rgyur bsgom pa'i tshul dang / sbyor ba khyad par can sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa so sor nges pa'i rgyur bsgom

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 183pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la sbyor ba tsam ngos gzung ba dang / rten gyi gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i phan yon gyi sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang 'thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/de la dbye na/ tshogs lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / sbyor lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba gnyis/dang po la/ skabs 'dir thar pa cha mthun zhes bya zhing / de'i mtshan nyid ni/shes rab kyis chos bden pa'i mtshan ma med par shes shing / thabs kyis sbyin sogs kyi dge rtsa rang rgyud la bskyed par mkhas pa'i theg chen las dang po ba'i mngon rtogs de/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la ni/ 'dir nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ming gis bstan la/ rjes thob gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems kyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la ni/ rten gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pas gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa'i rgyal sras de/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyor lam pa mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag dang gsum/skabs 'dir rtags kyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog tu bsgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba de/ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni dper na/ ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon chos can/

184 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin te/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa'i rjes thob kyi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir zhes dang / de chos can/ snying rje chen po dang ldan te/ rjes thob tu gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba yang 'tshol ba'i phyir zhes pa lta bu 'bras bu'i rtags dang / de chos can/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes rgyud la 'byung du rung ba yin te/sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ba'i phyir zhes pa rang bzhin gyi rtags so/ /gnyis pa la/ sku gsum so sor nges pa'i rgyu sbyor ba bshad pa dang / 'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang / gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bor chos kyi sku'i don du srid zhi rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams la srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba tsam ni sbyor lam nas yod la/ sa brgyad pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po gang rung gi ngo bor skyes pa de/ 'bor ba'i mtshan nyid/ las nyon ma lus par spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de/myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bor gzugs kyi sku'i zhing sbyang ba'i don du phyin drug nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang nyid gang du sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de'i snod kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang / bcud kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis/ sa mtshams la tsam ni sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can sa dgu pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /

skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ 185gnyis pa ni/ gtso bor 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i ched du stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i yul rnam pa bcu mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang /sogs khongs na rnam thar sgo gsum dang / byang phyogs so bdun la sde tshan bdun du byas pa rnams 'don no/ /dbye na/ dgra las 'das pa la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bcu/ bdud bzhi ma lus par spangs pa'i dbyings mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor de/ dgra las 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ces sogs sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir thabs mkhas ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la bya la/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na bcu/ bcu po mngon sum du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i rnal 'byor de la sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /zhar la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo dang spangs pa'i sa mtshams la/ nye bar len pa'i phung po de/ phung po'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum pa'i las nyon gang rung de/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rang dbang med par 'chi ba'i ngor skyes pa de/ 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi mtshan nyid/bdud gzhan gsum las 'da' ba la bar du gcod byed gang zhig 'dod lha'i rigs su gtogs pa de lha'i bu'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ bcom pa'i sa mtshams la/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam nas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ byang sems kyi mthong lam nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud gnyis bcom/ sa brgyad pa nas phung po'i bdud kyang bcom mo/ de dag ni rags pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas pa dang bdud bzhi ma lus par spangs pa dus mnyam mo/ /

186 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rnam pa brgya dang bdun bcu gsum/ /rnam kun rdzogs par byang chub pa'i/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams ni/ /rnam mang mdo dang gzhung bzhin bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs bzhi pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 187sgyu ma'i mdzad pa stong phrag mang po yis /sgyu ma'i 'gro ba 'di dag 'dun mdzad nas/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gsal bar ston mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po bcom ldan der phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis pa dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la/ so so skye bo'i rtse sbyor dang / 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ngo bor skyes pa/ dbye na bzhi las/ mdo las rtags bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rtags kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/de ni drod kyi rtse sbyor dang don gcig rtags bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag la/ mdo las dang po drug la rmi lam gyi rtags su gsungs shing / bdun pa la rmi lam dang sad rmi 'dems kha can du mdzad/ lhag ma rnams la yang sad rmi gnyis ka'i gsal ka ma mdzad do/ /bud+dhā shris ni dang po drug rmi lam gyi rtags/ de nas gnyis sad rmi gnyis ka'i rtags/ mtha' ma bzhi sad pa'i rtags su bzhed/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis dang po drug rmi lam gyi rtags dang / phyi ma drug sad pa'i rtags su bzhed/ lo tsā ba chen pos dang po brgyad 'bras rtags dang / phyi ma bzhi rang bzhin gyi rtags su bzhed/mdo las rnam 'phel bcu drug gis mtshon nas dngos su bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rnam 'phel rtse sbyor gyi mtshan

188 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/nyid/ de ni rtse mo'i rtse sbyor dang don gcigamado laru/ brtan pa bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ nges par brtan pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bzod pa'i rtse sbyor dang don gcigamado las rjes su yi rang gis mtshon nas dngos su bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni chos mchog gi rtse sbyor dang don gcigaganyis pa 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor la/ shes sgrib rags pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i rtse sbyor dang / gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ mthong lam rtse sbyor dang / sgom lam rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ spang bya rtog pa bshad pa dang / gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la ji lta ba bzhin ma yin par zhen pa'i blo gang zhig kun btags kyi char gyur pa de/ mthong spang rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mthong spang du gyur pa'i gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis/ rtog pa kun btags gang zhig yul gzung ba la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / ldog pa gzung ltortog gnyis/ lto)ga pa kun btags gang zhig dmigs yul theg chen gyi 'epyos la dmigs nas 'jug byar zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgu/ kun btags su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig dmigs yul theg dman gyi chos la dmigs nas ldog byar zhen pa'i blo de/mthong spang du gyur pa'i ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgu/

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 189kun btags su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par mngon par zhen pa'i blo de mthong spang 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gang zag la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i 'dzin rtog gang zhig gang zag la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/dbye na dgu/ de gang zhig gdags gzhir gyur pa'i phung po la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu/mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'jin par zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spang btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na skyes bu la btags 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos la btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ de gang zhig yul skyes bu tsam la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig yul skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i phung po lnga la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu/ 'dir skye 'phags gnyis ka la so sor nges par bshad pa ni mthong spang du gyur pa'i gang zag la rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang / gang zag la btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ chos la rdzas 'dzin gyi dbang du byas pa min no/ /gnyis pa la/ nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis spang bya rtog pa spangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i nyer len can gyi 'bras bu bshad pa dang / nyer len gyi

190 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen bshad pa dang / 'bras bu byang chub chen po dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang 'bras byang chub chen po'i nyer len gyi rgyu nus pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i rkyen de/ byang chub chen pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos la 'god pa/ rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa/ rang byang chub kyi rgyu la sbyor ba dang gsum/gnyis pa byang chub chen po la dngos dang / zhar la rnal 'byor sa bzhi bshad pa'o/ /dang po la byang chen tsam dang / 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang chen gnyis/dang po ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum la bya ste/ ji skad du/ sku gsum dag gi byang chub che/ /zhes bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dri ma zad skye bden pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang chen ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ ye shes kho na'i cha nas bshad pa la 'gal ba med do / /gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan gyi rnal 'byor sa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa dang bzhi/skye 'jig can gyi rtags la brten nas nyer len gyi phung po bdag med du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sa

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 191mtshams tshogs lam nas yod do/ /lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags la brten nas gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong par rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sbyor lam drod nas so/ /phyi don bden par med pa'i rtags kyis de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa bdag med du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas so/ /rten 'brel gyi rtags la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa bdag med du rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams tsam gyi dbang du byas na dbu ma pa'i sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can gyi dbang du byas na byang sems kyi mthong lam nas so/ /gnyis pa la sbong lam bshad pa dang / khyad par gyi lam bshad pa gnyis/dang po la/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig mthong spang gi sa bon la dngos su gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de/rme thong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dngos btags ma phye ba'i sgo nas dbye na/sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang / 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i mthong spang gi sa bon la cha shas su phye nas gnod pa byed cing drungs 'byin mi nus pa/ de ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog gi ye shes lta bu'o/ /de gang zhig der gyur pa'i de'i sa bon rnams bsdoms nas drungs 'byin nus

192 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi lam la mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog tshul gnyis/ mthong lam gyi khyad par gyi lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu/mthong lam gyi rjes thob la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi rten 'brel lugs 'byung dang / lugs ldog tu rtog par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/'dir bstan gyi rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/'dir rten 'brel gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ g.yo ba med pa dang mi rtag pa dang nus pa'i rkyen gsum las byung ba de/ rten 'brel tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid dang pos rgyu med yin pa bsal/ gnyis pas rgyu rtag pa las skye ba bsal/gsum pas rigs mi mthun las skye ba bsal/ de yang mdo las/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams so zhes sogs tshig gsum gsungs pa'i don dang sbyar ro/ /de la dbye na/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel dang / rnam byang gi rten 'brel gnyis/dang po la/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal skye ba'i rim pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ ma rig pa nas rga 'chi'i bar bcu gnyis so/ /'di la spyir ngos gzung ba dang / bye brag tu gang zag gcig gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po la/ rig pa ye shes kyi 'gal zlar gyur pa'i sems byung rmongs pa de /

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 193ma rig pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa dang / nyon mongs pa can min pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ phyi ma ni 'dir mi gzung la/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ de gang zhig yang srid 'phen byed kyi las kun nas slong bar nus pa/ de la dbye na/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi don la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i sems byung rmongs pa gang zhig bsod nams min pa'i las kun nas slong byed de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de kho na nyid kyi don mi shes pa'i sems byung rmongs pa gang zhig bsod nams dang mi g.yo ba'i las kun nas slong byed de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/yang ma rig pa la dbye na/ rgyu'i kun slong du gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang / dus kyi kun slong du gyur pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phen byed kyi las kun slong gi ma rig pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'grub byed kyi las kun slong gi ma rig pa lta bu'o/ /yang ma rig pa la dbye na/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang / sgom spang du gyur pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ yid shes 'khor du byung ba'i ma rig pa kun btags lta bu yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon yid 'khor gyi ma rig pa lta bu la bya'o/ /ma rig pas kun nas bslangs pa'i zag bcas kyi las de/ 'dir bstan 'du byed kyi rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bsod nams kyi las/ bsod nams min pa'i las/ mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum/ de la yang 'phen byed kyi las dang /'grub byed kyi las gnyis gnyis yod do/ /las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes de/ 'dir bstan rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la rgyu dus kyi rnam shes dang / 'bras dus kyi rnam shes gnyis/

194 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/dang po ni/ las gsog pa'i dus kyi rnam shes la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ nying mtshams sbyar ba'i dus kyi rnam shes la bya/ de yang kun gzhi bzhed pa ltar na kun gzhi'i rnam shes la bya/ mi bzhed pa ltar na yid kyi rnam shes la bya'o/ /rang rgyu las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes las 'byung zhing / nur nur po la sogs pa'i gzugs phung dang por grub pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga po gang rung de/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ming gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/'dir ming ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa dang bzhi la bya/gzugs ni nur nur po nas skye mched drug ma dod pa'i bar gyi lus la bya'o/ /rang rgyu ming dang gzugs las 'byung zhing skye mched drug dang por tshang ba'i gnas skabs kyi skye mched de/ 'dir bstan skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi skye mched sogs drugarang rgyu yul dbang yid byed gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum gang rung du spyod par byed pa'i sems byung de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i reg pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drugarang rgyu reg pas yul gsum gang rung du yongs su spyad pa las sim gdung bar ma gsum gang rung gi ngo bor nyams su myong ba'i sems byung de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba sogs drugarang rgyu tshor ba'i rkyen can gyis bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la blang dor bya bar 'dod pa'i sred pa de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i sred pa'i mtshan

skabs lnga pa rtse smo'i sbyor ba/ 195nyid/ dbye na/ 'dod sred/ gzugs sred/ gzugs med kyi sred pa dang gsum/de yang tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa na de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bde ba 'thob par 'dod pa'i sred pa skye/ de la yang gsum ste/ 'dod yon la sred pa lta bu 'dod sred/ bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi bde ba dang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i btang snyoms la sred pa ni gzugs kyi sred pa/ gzugs med kyi tshor ba btang snyoms la sred pa ni gzugs med kyi sred pa'o/ /sred pa de nyid shas cher 'phel ba'i sems byung 'dod chags de/ 'dir bstan len pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'dod pa nye ba ra len pa/ lta ba nye bar len pa/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs nye bar len pa/ bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa dang bzhi/rang rgyu len pa'i rkyen gyis yang srid 'grub byed kyi las nus pa mthu can de/'dir bstan srid pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyir srid pa tsam gyi ming can mang du bshad kyang srid pa 'di la dbye ba ma bshad do/ /sred len gnyis la yang rgyu'i kun slong gnyis/ dus kyi kun slong gnyis ka yod la/ srid pa la yang 'phen 'grub kyi cha gnyis ka yod do/ /las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis yang srid phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba'i phung po de/ 'dir bstan gyi skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mngal nas skye ba dang /rgo nga las skye ba/ drod gsher las skye ba/ rdzus nas skye ba dang bzhi'o/ /las nyon gyi dbang gis na tshod gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de 'dir bstan rga 'chi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rga ba dang 'chi ba gnyis/gnyis pa 'gro ba gcig gi rten 'brel bye brag tu bshad pa la/ mi lta bu'i

196 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/'gro ba gcig tu 'phen par byed pa'i las kun nas slong byed kyi ma rig pa de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu ma rig pa'i dbang gis mi lta bu'i 'gro ba rigs mthun gcig tu 'phangs pa'i zag bcas kyi las de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i jitsholcosgru lto ghu na ོ dzo|( yo 5 phrok+ka tha sgyuḍā |k+torwa glorta tro 5rko/klo/gyu 7྅7 sgru| rtso shā rta/ sh+lau k+to 7 chags balhasnas pa'i rnam shes de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dir ni rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kho na la 'dod dgos so/ /mir 'phen byed kyi las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi ming gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du mtshan mchosan gnyis ka la sbyar nas/ de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig gi yang srid phyi ma'i skye mched drug 'byung rung gi nus pa de/ skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ de'i steng gi yul yongs su gcod par byed pa'i reg pa 'byung rung gi nus pa de reg pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba rigs mthun gcig gi tshor ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de/ de'i tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi lta bu'i bde ba la sred pa'i sgo nas mir 'grub byed kyi las kun nas slong byed de/de'i sred pa'i mtshan nyid/ mi lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig gi tshor ba bde ba'i rgyu len par byed pa'i sgo nas mir 'grub byed kyi las gsog par byed pa de/ de'i len pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu sred len gyi dbang gis 'du byed nas tshor ba'i bar gyi nus pa mthu can du byas pa'i zag bcas kyi las de/ de'i srid pa'i mtshan nyid/rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis ma'i skye gnas su nying mtshams sbyar ba'i gnas skabs kyi phung po de/ mi'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 197ming gzugs nas tshor ba'i bar lnga'o/ /de yang snga ma dang khyad par yod de/ 'dir ni de dag mngon du gyur pa'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis mi lta bu'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i phung po'i rgyun gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur pa'i gnas skabs de/ de'i rga 'chi'i mtshan nyid/ de ltar bcu gnyis po thams cad rgyu 'bras tshar gcig gi dbang du byas nas 'chad pa 'di ni/ thogs med sku mched kyi thun mong min pa'i lugs yin la/ gzhung gzhan la rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa de ni/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel dang / de nas lhar skye ba lta bu'i rten 'brel bsres pa'i rnam gzhag yin no/ /'o na mdo las sred pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba 'byung bar gsungs pa dang rten 'brel tshar gcig pa'i lugs 'di 'gal te/ lugs 'di la ming gzugs sogs grub pa la sred len srid pa gsum sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir zhe na/ nyes pa med de/ de 'grub pa la de sngon du 'gro dgos su zin kyang 'phangs pa'i yan lag tu bzhag pa'i tshor ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de la sred pa mngon gyur pa 'byung ba mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ de ltar 'gro ba gcig gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis po de yang 'gro ba rigs mi mthun pa gsum mam/ gnyis kyi rten la rdzogs dgos pa yin te/'dod pa'i lha lta bu'i rten la mir 'phen byed kyi las bsags/ dud 'gro lta bu'i rten la mir 'phen byed kyi las bsags/ 'grub byed kyi las mngon du gyur nas mir skye dgos pa'i phyir/'dir sa mtshungs dpyad pa la/ yan lag bcu gnyis po 'di sa mtshungs sam mi mtshungs she na/ yan lag dang po dang rnam shes ni gang du las gsog pa'i sa de kho nar gtogs pa yin te/ sku mched gnyis kyis ma rig pa ni nyon yid 'khor gyi

198 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ma rig pa dang / rnam par shes pa rgyu dus kyi kun gzhi nyid bshad pa'i phyir/'jug shes 'khor gyi ma rig pa dang / 'bras dus kyi rnam shes la 'dod pa'i lugs la ni rnam bshad las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'du byed la sogs pa'i bcu po de ni sa mtshungs pa kho na yin te/ sa gzhan gyi las kyis sa gzhan gyi phung po 'phen zhing 'grub par byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang / sa gzhan gyi las gsos 'debs byed kyi nyon mongs pas sa gzhan gyi las gsos 'debs mi nus pa'i phyir/ 'o na gong ma'i rten la 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba yod par thal/ gzugs khams nas ngan song du skye ba'i tshe sred len srid pa gsum po ngan song du gtogs dgos pa'i phyir ro zhen/ nyes pa med de/ gong ma'i dngos gzhi'i sems las nyams pa'i gong sa'i rten las 'og ma'i nyon mongs 'byung ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ don gsang rnam par bshad pa las/ skye ba'i sa pa gang yin pa mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nges par de'i sa pa'o zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spangs bya rtog pa ji ltar spong ba'i tshul dang / des spangs pas thob pa'i brten pa yon tan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ gnyen po sgom lam rtse sbyor dang / spangs bya rtog pa gnyis/dang po la/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig sgom spang rtog pa'i sa bon la gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal gnyis/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan spel bar gang yang med par lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gnyis kyi sgo nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 199snyoms 'jug de/ seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi ting nge 'dzin tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mthong lam gyi skabs nas bstan pa'i khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / sgom lam gyi skabs nas bstan pa'i spong lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings gnyis/ dang po ni bshad zin la/seng ge rnam bsgyings gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya sgom spang gi sa bon la cha shas re re nas gnod par byed cing drungs 'byin mi nus pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ /rnam pa gnyis su song zhes pa'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin cerdzo/ /rang rgyu sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gang rung gi sgo nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang byar gyur pa'i sgom spang gi sa bon drungs 'byin nus pa de/ dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ thod rgal chung ngu / 'bring / chen po gsum/rang rgyu sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po ma skyes gong der mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan spel bar gang yang med par lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug de/dang po'i mtshan nyid/rang rgyu dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu sngon du btang nas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang po brgyad dang 'gog pa spel te lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug cing /'gog pa nas srid rtse la nud chung byed pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/

200 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rang rgyu dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po sngon du btang nas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu dang 'dod sems spel te lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ltar thod rgal chung ngu la gnas dgu/ 'bring po la bcu bdun/ chen po la bco brgyad/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings la bcu bdun rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci 'o1ga tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhigalhan skyes kyi char gyur pa de/ sgom spang rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzhi/ de re re la'ang dgu dgu ste so drug de yang khams gsum du so sor phye bas brgya dang bco brgyad/ so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ lhan skyes zhes sbyar ba ma gtogs mthong spang gi skabs bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ theg pa gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i 'gal rkyen mngon gyur pa zad cing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa de/ sgom lam gyi brten pa yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams ni sa bcu pa nas yod do/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos dang / dmigs rnam gnyis/ dang po la/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i dngos rgyur gyur pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun mtha'i ye shes la bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dmigs rnam dngos dang / dmigs rnam la rtsod pa'i log sgrub gnyis/ dang po la/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi de/ de'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni bden stong sgyu ma lta bu la zer/ bar

skabs lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ 201chad med lam pa'i rtse sbyor rang dbang du skyed byed de/ de'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun mtha' man chad kyi dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa la zer/bar chad med rtses yul rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ de'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni spros bral rtogs pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes la bya'o/ /zhar la de ma thag rkyen ni rig pa snga ma la bya'o/ /de ni slob dpon gyi bzhed pa'o/ /'phags pa ltar na stong gsum skye bo zhes pa'i skabs su/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de rnam mkhyen gyi de ma thag rkyen du bstan nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdag rkyen dang dmigs rkyen ston byed du gzhung phyi ma gsungs par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa log sgrub la/ bden gnyis gang rung re re rgyu mtshan du byas nas cig shos sun 'byin pa'i log rtog gam/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i rtsod ngag gang rung de/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la rtsod pa'i log sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/de la dbye na/ log rtog dang / rtsod ngag gnyis/ de re re la yang bcu drug bcu drug go /'di'i dang po ni/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyis sel la/ gnyis pa ni/ de la bstan pa'i lan gyis sel bar byed do/ /'dir rtsod pa'i tshul la rnam pa bzhi ste/kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam sun 'byin par byed pa dang / don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob sun 'byin par byed pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob nyid sun 'byin par byed pa dang / don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam nyid sun 'byin par byed pa'o/ /dang po gsum gzhung las dngos su gsungs shing / phyi ma dngos su ma gsungs kyang don gyis thob bo/ /klan ka dang po la don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs/ gnyis pa la kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs par gzhung las gsungs la/ phyi ma gnyis la bden pa gnyis ka'i sgo

202 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/nas lan 'debs par don gyis thob bo/ /rtse sbyor yan lag 'phros dang bcas/ /rtse bar yum gyi mdo dang ni/ / rtse gyur gzhung lugs mang po nas/ /rtse mo'i blo yis bsdus te bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs lnga pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

skabs drug pa mthar gyis pa'i spyor ba/ 203stong nyid mar gad bzhus pa'i chu gter du/ /mngon rtogs shel dkar lbu ba 'dren 'dra ba'i/ /rgyal yum rgya mtsho'i snying po 'dren mdzad pa/ / mi pham srid zhi'i mes po der phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la/ rgyu mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang / 'bras bu skad/ cig ma'i sbyor ba gnyis/dang po la/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la brtan pa 'thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ lam gyi ngo bo phyin drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba dang / lam khyad par du byed pa rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba dang / lam rnam par dag byed dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba dang gsum/ shes rnam brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum dang phyin drug zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa 'thob phyir du slob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ skye med gsum gyi shes rnam dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la slob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ spyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ces sbyar bar bya'o/ /de re re la'ang mthar gyis bya ba dang / mthar gyis bslab pa dang / mthar gyis bsgrub pa gsum gsum du 'byed de/ ji skad du/ mdo las/ sbyin pas mthar gyis pa'i bya ba dang mthar gyis pa'i bslab pa dang mthar gyis pa'i sgrub pa rab tu 'dogs te zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum po yang 'phags pa ltar na rim pa bzhin du tshogs lam

204 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/dang / sbyor lam dang / mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis dang sbyor la/ slob dpon ltar na/sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi lam gnyis dang sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa la/ skye med gsum gyi shes rnam dang rjes dran drug zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa 'thob phyir du slob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas skye med gsum gyi shes rnam la brtan pa 'thob phyir du slob pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ces sogs lhag ma lnga po la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de re re la'ang mthar gyis bya ba dang / bslab pa dang / sgrub pa gsum gsum du phye'o/ /'dir rjes dran drug po so so'i ngo bo la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mtshan dpe sogs nas byang phyogs so bdun gyi bar don dam par dran pa med cing / kun rdzob tu mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas sgyu ma lta bur rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan gyi sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mtshan nyid/ kun rdzob tu dran tshul ni rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa zhes sogs kyi sgo nas rjes su dran pa'o/ /'di la sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su dran pa nyer bzhag dang dbang po dang stobs gsum dran pa ni/ sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi dbang du byas pa'i mthar gyis bya ba dang / mthong lam du byang chub yan lag bdun sngar ltar rjes su dran pa de'i dbang du byas pa'i mthar gyis bslab pa dang / sgom lam du 'phags lam yan lag brgyad sngar ltar dran pa ni/ de'i dbang du byas pa'i mthar gyis sgrub pa'o/ /dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi chos rnams don dam par dran pa med cing / kun rdzob tu mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas sgyu ma lta bur rjes su dran pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan gyi

skabs drug pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ 205chos rjes dran gyi mtshan nyid/ mdo las bshad pa ltar na skyes bu zung bzhi dang /'grel ba ltar na byang sems kyi dge 'dun snga ma ltar dran pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan gyi dge 'dun rjes dran gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la mthar gyis bya ba sogs gsum du 'byed pa mdo'i dgongs pa min no/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims gsum dang / gtong ba gsum dang / lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa snga ma de ltar rjes su dran pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de/ phyi ma gsum gyi mtshan nyid/gsum pa la/ chos thams cad bden pa'i ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas brtan pa 'thob phyir du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la mthar gyis bya ba sogs gsum du 'byed pa ni mdo'i dgongs pa min no/ /mdor na/ skye med gsum sgom pa dang / dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs nas sgom pa ni don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ / mthar gyis sgom pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /mthar thug chos sku'i khang bzang der/ /mthar phyin byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mthar son mdo yi lugs bzhin bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs drug pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

206 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/snyan grags 'dzum gyi pad dkar phreng ba gang / /yon gnas mdza' bo'i rna ba'i mdongs pa la/ /rnam par bkod pas sngon med rtse dga'i dpal/ /stsol mdzad dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la/ dngos dang / sbyor bzhi'i don ldog bsdus te bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ skye med gsum la brtan pa thob nas cig char du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'a byor de/ skad cig sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rtogs byed blo'i sgo nas yon tan mngon du byed pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / rtogs bya yul gyi sgo nas yul rtogs tshul gyi skad cig sbyor gnyis/dang po la/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor gnyis/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ dus skad cig ma gcig la rnam par smin pa'i sbyin pa nas dpe byad bzang po'i bar gyi zag med kyi chos rnams mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/blo skad cig ma gcig gis rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ dus skad cig ma gcig la rnam par smin pa'i ngo bor skyes pa'i zag med kyi chos rnams mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa bdun pa man chad du thob pa'i zag med kyi yon tan de/'dir bstan rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi chos kyi mtshan nyid/ dag pa sa

skabs bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ 207gsum gyi gnas skabs su thob pa'i zag med kyi yon tan de rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi chos kyi mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig sbyor dang / gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor gnyis/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis dus skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/blo skad cig ma gcig gis dus skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis med du shes pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/gnyis pa la mdor bsdu na skabs phyi ma bzhi'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba bzhi'i don ldog ni 'di yin te/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang 'thob phyir du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po tsam gyi ngo bor skyes shing de'i spong gnyen gyi ngo bor ma skyes pa de/ skabs bzhi pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de ni tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /de ltar na skabs bzhi par sbyor lam dang mthong lam rjes thob kyi cha nas bshad cing / mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam gyi cha nas ma ngapond/ 〉tem lam yang 'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam zhes bsam byung gi shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'i cha nas rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po tsam du bshad kyi/ sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i cha nas sbong gnyen du ma bshad do/ /mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa'i sems dpa'i

208 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon la gnod pa byed pa'i sgo nas de'i spang gnyen gyi ngo bor skyes pa de/ skabs lnga pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de yang skabs lnga par/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor 'chad pa na rtags sogs kyis mtshon nas mnyam gzhag gi ngo bor gyur pa'i sbyor lam rtog pa bzhi'i spang gnyen du gyur pa'i de nyid kyi cha nas bshad la/ mthong sgom bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gsum yang bar chad med lam gyi cha nas bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar na dbang thob ma thob kyi don yang de nyid do/ /sbyor ba phyi ma gnyis kyi don ldog gi skabs su brtan pa thob ma thob kyi don ni/ skye med gsum rtogs pa'i blo de nyid sbyin pa la sogs pa'i chos gzhan dang zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la 'bad rtsol yod med la byed pa yin la/ de yang mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni sbyor ba'i lam dang / rnam par grol ba'i lam dang / khyad par gyi lam gsum po gang rung gi cha nas bshad/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig nyid yin kyang rnam grol lam gyi cha nas bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang rtse sbyor 'gal ba yin te/ dbang ma thob pa 'thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa dang thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ rnam rtse gnyis dang mthar gyis sbyor ba yang 'gal ba yin te/ rnam rtse gnyis ni skye med gsum rkyang pa la rnal 'byor du gyur ba'i cha nas bshad la/ mthar gyis pa ni/ sbyin sogs chos bcu gsum la rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i cha nas bshad pa'i phyir/ bar chad med rtse dang skad cig sbyor gnyis ni/ye shes ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye bas mi 'gal la/ mthar gyis pa dang skad cig sbyor gnyis kyang 'gal ba yin te/ chos gcig la brtan pa 'thob phyir du bsgom pa dang / thob nas bsgom pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /

skabs bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ 209skad cig ma yi blo gros kyis/ /skad cig gcig la chos rnams kun/ /skad cig gnyis par byang chub pa'i/ /skad cig sbyor ba gzhung bzhin bshad/ /ces bya ba ni skabs bdun pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

210 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/phun tshogs srid pa'i 'byor pa brgya phrag gis/ /rnam par dregs pa'i lha brgya'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal ba'i thub rnams kyang / /gang gi zhabs rdul len der bdag kyang ngo / /gnyis pa 'bras bu chos sku la/ rten sku dang ye shes bshad pa dang / brten pa 'phrin las bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ sku bshad pa dang / zhar la ye shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ yul skye med gsum/ yul can sbyor bzhis nyams su blangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku de/ 'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sku gnyis su dbye ba/ gsum du dbye ba/ bzhir dbye ba/ lngar dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang don don dam pa'i chos sku dang / gzhan don kun rdzob pa'i gzugs sku gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi spangs rtogs gnyis la bya zhing /gnyis pa ni longs sprul gnyis la byed/ de skad du yang / rgyud bla mar/rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /zhes 'byung ngo / / gnyis pa ni/ rang don gyi sku dang / gzhan don gyi sku dang / de gnyis kyi rten gyi sku dang gsum/ dang po ni longs sku/ gnyis pa ni sprul sku/ gsum pa ni chos kyi sku'o/ /de skad du yang mdo sde rgyan las/

skabs brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku/ 211sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes byas te/ /sku gsum dag gi rang bzhin gyis/ /don ni rten dang bcas par bstan/ / ces so/ /gsum pa gzugs sku la 31ngas sprul gnyis dang / chos sku la spangs rtogs so sor phye nas spangs pa'i cha la ngo bo nyid sku dang / rtogs pa'i cha la rtogs pa ye shes chos skur bshad do/ /ji skad du/ de yang ngo bo nyid kyi sku la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ba zhi pa ni/ tshig gsal las/ 'ordzongs sku la sa bcu pa'i byang sems la snang ba'i longs sku chen po dang / sa dang po sogs la gnas pa'i byang sems sogs la snang ba'i longs sku chung ngu dang gnyis su 'byed pa'i lugs dang / yang na sprul sku la rnam par smin pa'i sprul sku dang / rnam par smin pa min pa'i sprul sku gnyis su phye nas lngar gsungs so/ /dang po ngo bo nyid kyi sku la mtshan nyid ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'gog bden mthar thug gam/ yang na yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i 'gog bden mthar thug go /yon tan lnga ni/ ji skad du/ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /

212 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges 'grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med dang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes 'dus ma byas pa dang / yon tan gyi chos dang dbyer med pa dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa dang / sgrib pa ma lus par spangs pa dang / 'od gsal ba'o/ /dri med sogs gsum ni 'od gsal ba'i sgrub byed do/ /gnyis pa ye shes chos sku la mtshan nyid ni/ gnas gyur mthar thug pa'i ye shes gang zhig gzugs sku gnyis kyi bdag rkyen du dmigs pa/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig la bya'o/ /sde tshan nyer gcig la 'ga' zhig ni bshad zin pas rtogs sla la/ zad par la rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi gang rung la brten nas/ rang gi dmigs pas shes bya mtha' yas pa la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mngon pa gong ma ltar na/ rnam thar gyis mos shing zil gnon gyi dbang du byas pa'i dmigs pa 'dod dgur spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ zad par gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na

skabs brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku/ 213bcu las/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul shes bya mtha' yas pa la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ zad par sa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas dkar po'i bar la bsgre bar bya zhing / gzugs med nam mkha'i dngos gzhi la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul nam mkhas shes bya mtha' yas pa la khyab par spro ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ zad par nam mkha'i skye mched kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs med rnams kyi dngos gzhi la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul rnam par shes pas shes bya sogs bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /'dir zad par shes pa dang / mtha' dag dang / mtha' yas dang / khyab pa zhes pa rnams ni ming gi rnam grangs so/ /sde tshan drug pa zil gnon la/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas dmigs pa la dbang 'byor ba'i sgo nas dmigs pa zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de mtshan nyid do/ /de la dbye na/ dbyibs dang kha dog zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched gnyis/dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ de la brten nas de la dbang 'byor bas dbyibs zil gyis gnon pa'i ting 'dzin zhes sogs so/ /de la dbye na/ nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu la lta ba'i zil gnon dang / chen po la lta ba'i zil gnon dang gnyis/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu la lta ba dang / chen po la lta ba'i zil gnon gnyis te bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de la brten nas rnal 'byor pa rang la gzugs med par 'du shes pas kha dog zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i zhes sogs so/ /de

214 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/sangs rgyas kyi sku'i cha mdzes par byed pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad kyi mtshan nyid/ yang na sangs rgyas kyi sku'i cha mdzes par byed pa'i byed chos kyi gtso bo de /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang / gtso bo de'i 'khor du byung ba de de'i dpe byad do/ /de yang mtshan rnams ni gtso bo yin pas/ re re'ang phyin drug gi rgyu las byung bar skal bzang las gsungs la/ dpe byad rnams ni 'khor yin pas re re la rgyu drug drug gi nges pa med do/ /de yang smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu kha dog dkar ba ni sbyin pa'i 'bras bu dang / g.yas su 'khyil ba ni tshul khrims kyi/ zil gyis gnon pa ni bzod pa'i/ rang gi sar gnas pa ni brtson 'grus kyi/ legs par gnas pa ni bsam gtan gyi/ 'od mtha' yas pas khyab pa ni shes rab kyi 'bras bu yin pa sogs gsungs shing / sor mo dang sen mo'i dpe byad drug phyag sor ring ba'i 'khor yin pa sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa sprul sku la mtshan nyid ni/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku mthar thug khyad par bzhi ni/ ji skad du/'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs/ /zhes pa ste/ gdul bya thar pa'i lam la sbyo ra ba/ theg chen du smin par byed pa/byang chub tu lung ston pa ste/ 'bras bu'i khyad par gsum dang / rgyu'i khyad par longs sku'i dbang gis byung ba'o/ /dbye na/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i don du dri zar skye ba bzhes pa lta bu bzo'i sprul ba dang / sems can gyi don du ri dwags ru rur skye ba bzhes pa lta bu skye ba'i dang / shākya thub pa lta bu mchog gi sprul

skabs brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku/ 215sku dang gsum ste/ ji skad du/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes la ma/tshan nyid/ gnas gyur mthar thug pa'i ye shes so/ /dbye na me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang bzhi yin la/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes gsungs pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku la ye shes kyi ming gis btags pa yin no/ /ye shes dang po ni/ mi g.yo ba dang rten yin la/ gsum po ni/ g.yo ba dang de la brten pa yin no/ /de skad du yang mdo sde rgyan las/me long ye shes mi g.yo ste/ /ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ /zhes so/ /khyad par lnga ldan gyi ye shes gang zhig longs sku gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du 'byung zhing / ye shes gzhan gsum gyi 'byung gnas su dmigs pa de/ ye shes dang po'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par lnga ni/me long ye shes nga yi med/ /yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan/ /shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa/ /rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min// /zhes pa dang / sgra bshad pa yang / ji skad du/ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /

216 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ye shes 'byung gnas chen po 'dra/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ye shes gzugs brnyan 'byung ba'i phyir/ /zhes gan+da/ngas tre(/ /rgyu'i khyad par bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid bsgoms pa las byung zhing / ngo bo'i khyad par mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la zhugs shing / mthu'i khyad par byams pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de/ ye shes gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de skad du yang /sgom pa dag pa sems can la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes 'dod/ /mi gnas zhi bar zhugs pa ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yin par 'dod/ /dus rnams kun tu byams pa dang / /thugs rje chen po dag dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs rbe1/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas shes bya'i khyad par ma 'dres par mkhyen cing / byed las kyi sgo nas ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi byed las su gyur pa de/ ye shes gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji skad du/so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /

skabs brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku/ 217la dbye na/ sngon po zil gyis gnon pa sogs bzhi'o/ /sde tshan bdun pa la/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs la rjes su bsrungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dang gnyis so/ /sde tshan brgyad pa smon pas shes pa la mtshan nyid ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas ji ltar bsam pa'i don de nyid shes par nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes sogs so/ /dbye na nyan thos kyi dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dang gnyis so/ /gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la mtshan nyid ni/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku mthar thug khyad par lnga ni/ sku ston pa/ gsung brjod pa/ thugs mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa/ de dag kun la btags pa'i dngos med pa dang / sna tshogs su snang yang de'i ngo bor med pa de/ ji skad du/brjod don mdzad rgyun mi chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / /de'i ngo bor mi ston la/ /de ni sna tshogs rnam lngar brjod/ /ces so/ /nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug ces pa la re zhig khungs med pas btang snyoms su gzhag go /longs sku'i yon tan mtshan dang dpe byad gnyis/gzugs phung gis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gang zhig skyes bu chen por mtshon par byed pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mtshan nyid dang / de gang zhig

218 shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs su sprul bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i ye shes de/ ye shes bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ de skad du yang /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /khams gsum kun tu sna tshogs shing / /dpag med bsam yas sprul ba yi/ /sems can don kun bsgrub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'phrin las la/ ye shes chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi bya ba de/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid/ de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ byed pa po la yod pa'i 'phrin las dang / bya ba'i yul la yod pa'i 'phrin las gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud la yod la/gnyis pa ni gdul bya gzhan rgyud la yod do/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las dang / rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa/ lam la 'god pa/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa dang gsum/chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas gdul bya ngan song gi rten las ldog nas
